With the help of new friend and FBI-insider, Canton Everett Delaware the Third, our heroes are reunited to share their discoveries, if not their memories. For the world is occupied by an alien force who control humanity through post-hypnotic suggestion and no one can be trusted. Aided by President Nixon and Neil Armstrong's foot, the Doctor must mount a revolution to drive out the enemy and rescue the missing little girl. No-one knows why they took her. Or why they have kidnapped Amy Pond...

Episodes.Title: The Curse of the Black Spot
Episodes.Description: The TARDIS is marooned onboard a 17th-century pirate ship whose crew is being attacked by a mysterious and beautiful sea creature. Becalmed and beset by cabin fever, the pirates have numerous superstitious explanations for the Siren's appearance. The Doctor has other ideas but, as his theories are disproved and every plan of escape is thwarted, he must work to win the trust of the implacable Captain Avery and uncover the truth behind the pirates' supernatural fears – and he must work quickly, for some of his friends have already fallen under the Siren's spell...

Episodes.Title: The Doctor's Wife
Episodes.Description: The Doctor receives a distress signal from an old friend. Could there really be another living Time Lord out there? Hopes raised, he follows the signal to a junkyard planet sitting upon a mysterious asteroid in a Bubble universe, populated by a very strange family, as the time-travelling drama continues. The Doctor, Amy and Rory are given the warmest of welcomes by Auntie, Uncle and Nephew. But the beautiful and insane Idris greets them in a more unusual fashion – what is she trying to tell the Doctor? As the Doctor investigates, he unwittingly puts his friends in the gravest danger.

Episodes.Title: The Rebel Flesh (1)
Episodes.Description:
A solar tsunami sends the TARDIS hurtling towards a futuristic factory on Earth, where human doppelgangers are used to mine dangerous acid, as the time-travelling adventures continue.

A second wave hits and the "Gangers" separate. They can remember every second of their "original's" life and feel every emotion they've ever experienced. But are these memories stolen or have they been bequeathed? Are the Gangers merely faulty machinery that must be shut down or are they living, breathing, sentient beings? Can the Doctor convince the terrified humans to accept these "almost people" and prevent an all-out civil war before the factory explodes?

Episodes.Title: The Almost People (2)
Episodes.Description:
As the solar storm rages, Jennifer, a Ganger driven mad by the memories of being "decommissioned", is seeking revenge, as the time-travelling drama continues.

She can remember every excruciating second of every "execution" and is determined that the humans will pay. And she isn't just talking war; she's talking revolution. As the crumbling factory fills with toxic fumes and drips lethal acid, the "Originals" wait desperately for the shuttle from the Mainland to rescue them. But Jennifer has other ideas. Can the Doctor convince the terrified factory workers to embrace their own humanity and work together with their Gangers to overcome a monster of their own making?

Episodes.Title: A Good Man Goes to War (1)
Episodes.Description:
Amy Pond has been kidnapped and the Doctor is raising an army to rescue her as the drama continues. But as he and Rory race across galaxies, calling in long-held debts and solemnly given promises, his enemies are laying a carefully concealed trap.

In her cell in Stormcage, River Song sadly acknowledges that the time has come at last – today will mark the Battle of Demons Run and the Doctor’s darkest hour. Both sides will make their sacrifices and River Song must finally reveal her most closely guarded secret to the Doctor.

Episodes.Title: Let's Kill Hitler (2)
Episodes.Description: In the desperate search for Melody Pond, the TARDIS crash lands in Thirties Berlin, as the time-travelling drama returns for the second half of the series shown earlier in the year. The Doctor comes face to face with the greatest war criminal in the Universe. And Hitler. Old friendships are tested to their limits as the Doctor suffers the ultimate betrayal and learns a harsh lesson in the cruelest warfare of all. As precious time ebbs away, the Doctor must teach his adversaries that time travel has responsibilities. And he must succeed before an almighty price is paid.

Episodes.Title: Night Terrors
Episodes.Description: A little boy named George sends a distress signal to the Doctor when he discovers that monsters live in his bedroom cupboard.

Episodes.Title: The Girl Who Waited
Episodes.Description: The TARDIS brings its crew to a quarantine facility for victims of an alien plague. When Amy is trapped, Rory must rescue her from the facility's doctors but learns something surprising about his wife.

Episodes.Title: The God Complex
Episodes.Description: The trio arrive at a hotel where the layout of the rooms keeps changing. It also contains rooms that hold the greatest fears of each visitor.

Episodes.Title: Closing Time
Episodes.Description: As the Doctor prepares for his inevitable death at Lake Silencio, he visits a former roommate and learns that the Cybermen are responsible for a series of disappearances at a local department store and resolves to investigate.

Episodes.Title: The Wedding of River Song
Episodes.Description: As the Doctor makes his final journey to the shores of Lake Silencio in Utah, he knows only one thing can keep the universe safe – his own death – in the concluding episode of this series of the time-travelling drama. But has he reckoned without the love of a good woman?

Episodes.Title: Asylum of the Daleks
Episodes.Description: Kidnapped by his oldest foe, the Doctor is forced on an impossible mission - to a place even the Daleks are too terrified to enter... the Asylum. A planetary prison confining the most terrifying and insane of their kind, the Doctor and the Ponds must find an escape route. But with Amy and Rory’s relationship in meltdown, and an army of mad Daleks closing in, it is up to the Doctor to save their lives, as well as the Pond’s marriage.

Episodes.Title: Dinosaurs on a Spaceship
Episodes.Description: An unmanned spaceship hurtles towards certain destruction - unless the Doctor can save it, and its impossible cargo... of dinosaurs! By his side a ragtag gang of adventurers; a big game hunter, an Egyptian Queen and a surprised member of the Pond family. But little does the Doctor know there is someone else onboard who will stop at nothing to keep hold of his precious, prehistoric cargo.

Episodes.Title: A Town Called Mercy
Episodes.Description: The Doctor gets a Stetson (and a gun!), and finds himself the reluctant Sheriff of a Western town under siege by a relentless cyborg, who goes by the name of the Gunslinger. But who is he and what does he want? The answer seems to lie with the mysterious, Kahler-Jex, an alien doctor (yes another one!) whose initial appearance is hiding a dark secret.

Episodes.Title: The Power of Three
Episodes.Description: The Doctor and the Ponds puzzle an unlikely invasion of Earth, as millions of sinister black cubes arrive overnight, almost like presents falling from the sky. But what are they, what’s inside them and most importantly, who sent them? With the international community at a loss, it’s left to the Doctor to unearth who is behind the mystery.

Episodes.Title: The Angels Take Manhattan
Episodes.Description: The Doctor’s heart-breaking farewell to Amy and Rory – a race against time through the streets of Manhattan, as New York’s statues come to life around them… With Rory’s life in danger, the Doctor and Amy must locate him before it’s too late! Luckily, an old friend helps them and guides the way.

Episodes.Title: The Bells of Saint John
Episodes.Description: When the Doctor receives a mysterious call from Clara, the woman that he's been seeking since he has seen her die twice, he arrives in 21st century Earth and discovers that something is using wi-fi to download human minds into the Internet... and feed on them.

Episodes.Title: The Rings of Akhaten
Episodes.Description: Clara wants to see something awesome, so the Doctor whisks her off to the inhabited rings of the planet Akhaten, where the Festival of Offerings is in full swing. Clara meets the young Queen of Years as the pilgrims and natives ready for the ceremony. But something is stirring in the pyramid, and a sacrifice will be demanded.

Episodes.Title: Cold War
Episodes.Description: The Doctor and Clara land on a damaged Russian submarine in 1983 as it spirals out of control into the ocean depths. An alien creature is loose on board, having escaped from a block of Arctic ice. With tempers flaring and a cargo of nuclear weapons on board, it’s not just the crew but the whole of humanity at stake!

Episodes.Title: Hide
Episodes.Description: Clara and the Doctor arrive at Caliburn House, a haunted mansion sat alone on a desolate moor. Within its walls, a ghost hunting Professor and a gifted psychic are searching for the Witch of the Well. Her apparition appears throughout the history of the building, but is she really a ghost? And what is chasing her?

Episodes.Title: Journey to the Centre of the TARDIS
Episodes.Description: When a salvage ship attempts to pull the TARDIS aboard when the time vessel's shields are down, an explosion occurs. The Doctor forces the salvage crew to help him find Clara, who is lost somewhere inside his vessel.

Episodes.Title: The Crimson Horror
Episodes.Description: Something ghastly is afoot in Victorian Yorkshire, as bodies are found with their skin a waxy, glowing red.

Episodes.Title: Nightmare in Silver
Episodes.Description: Hedgewick's World of Wonders: the perfect theme park day out - and ground zero for a deadly silver resurrection.

Episodes.Title: The Name of the Doctor
Episodes.Description: Someone is kidnapping the Doctor's friends, leading him towards the one place in all of time and space that he should never go.

Episodes.Title: Deep Breath
Episodes.Description: When a dinosaur materialises alongside the Houses of Parliament in Victorian London, the Doctor's old friends, the Paternoster Gang, are relieved when he arrives, seemingly to deal with the creature. However, they soon realise that the Doctor is the one in need of help; newly regenerated, extremely volatile and questioning his self-worth, this is a very different man to the one they last saw. The only person that may be able to help him is Clara, and she is still grappling with losing the Doctor she knew and loved.

Episodes.Title: Into the Dalek
Episodes.Description:
A Dalek fleet surrounds a lone rebel ship, and only the Doctor can help them now.
The Doctor faces his greatest enemy and he needs Clara by his side. Confronted with a decision that could change the Daleks forever he is forced to examine his conscience. Will he find the answer to his question - "Am I a good man?"

Episodes.Title: Robot of Sherwood
Episodes.Description: In a sun-dappled Sherwood Forest, The Doctor discovers an evil plan from beyond the stars. But with the fate of Nottingham at stake (and possibly Derby), there's no time for the two adventurers to get into a fight about who is real and who isn't - which is probably why they do very little else!

Episodes.Title: Listen
Episodes.Description: What scares the grand old man of time? What horrors lurk under his bed? Ghosts of the past and future crowd into the lives of The Doctor and Clara; a terrified caretaker in a children's home, the last man standing in the universe, and a little boy who doesn't want to join the army...

Episodes.Title: Time Heist
Episodes.Description: The Bank of Karabraxos is the deadliest bank in the cosmos - only a fool or genius would tempt to rob it. Fortunately, for The Doctor, he's both. But nothing even The Doctor has encountered can prepare them for the Teller: a creature of terrifying power that can detect guilt.

Episodes.Title: The Caretaker
Episodes.Description: Clara has it all under control: her life at school, her life in space; her new boyfriend and her mad old Time Lord. Everything is humming along just fine, so long as everybody never actually meets. And then, one morning, just before assembly, Coal Hill welcomes a new relief caretaker with a Scottish accent.

Episodes.Title: Kill the Moon
Episodes.Description: In the near future, The Doctor and Clara arrive on a decrepit shuttle making a suicide mission to the Moon. Crashing on the lunar surface, they find a mining base full of eviscerated corpses, spider-like creatures scuttling about in the dark, and a terrible dilemma.

Episodes.Title: Mummy on the Orient Express
Episodes.Description: Aboard the most beautiful train in history, speeding among the stars of the future, a legend is stalking the passengers. Once you see the Mummy, you have 66 seconds to live. Clara sees The Doctor at his deadliest and most ruthless - and finally she realises she's made the right decision. Because this is their last adventure: it's time to say goodbye to the Time Lord.

Episodes.Title: Flatline
Episodes.Description: Separated from The Doctor, Clara discovers a new menace from another dimension. But how do you hide when even the walls are no protection.

Episodes.Title: In the Forest of the Night
Episodes.Description: One morning in London, and every city and town in the world, the human race wakes up to the most surprising invasion yet: the trees have moved back in. Everywhere, in every land, a forest has grown overnight and taken back the Earth.

Episodes.Title: Dark Water
Episodes.Description: In the mysterious world of the Nethersphere, plans have been drawn. Old friends and old enemies manoeuvre around The Doctor, and an impossible choice is looming over him.

Episodes.Title: Death in Heaven
Episodes.Description: With Cybermen on the streets of London, old friends unite against old enemies and the Doctor takes to the air in a startling new role. As the Doctor faces his greatest challenge, sacrifices must be made before the day is won.

Episodes.Title: The Magician's Apprentice (1)
Episodes.Description: Where is the Doctor? When the skies of Earth are frozen by a mysterious alien force, Clara needs her friend. But where is the Doctor, and what is he hiding from? As past deeds come back to haunt him, old enemies will come face-to-face, and for the Doctor and Clara survival seems impossible.

Episodes.Title: The Witch's Familiar (2)
Episodes.Description: Trapped and alone in a terrifying Dalek city, the Doctor is at the heart of an evil Empire; no sonic, no TARDIS, nobody to help. With his greatest temptation before him, can the Doctor resist? And will there be mercy?

Episodes.Title: Under the Lake (1)
Episodes.Description: The Doctor and Clara save the frightened crew from a threat in an underwater base, but the Doctor questions the haunting.

Episodes.Title: Before the Flood (2)
Episodes.Description: An alien warlord sets a twisted plan in motion in order to ensure his survival on a remote Army outpost, and the Doctor may have to do something unthinkable.

Episodes.Title: The Girl Who Died (1)
Episodes.Description: In a Viking village, a girl named Ashildr is about to make a desperate mistake. The Mire are the deadliest mercenaries in the galaxy, famed for showing no mercy and Ashildr has just declared war on them. The Doctor and Clara have 12 hours to turn a peaceful village into strong fighters, ready for the deadly Mire.

Episodes.Title: The Woman Who Lived (2)
Episodes.Description: England, 1651. The deadly Highwayman 'The Knightmare' and his sidekick stalk the dark streets of London. But when they find loot that's not of this world, they come face to face with The Doctor. Who is the Nightmare in league with? And can the Doctor avoid the hangman's noose and protect Earth from a devilish betrayal?

Episodes.Title: The Zygon Invasion (1)
Episodes.Description: When Osgood is kidnapped by a rogue gang of Zygons, the Doctor, Clara and Unit must scatter across the world in a bid to set her free. But will they reach her in time, and can they stop an uprising before it is too late?

Episodes.Title: The Zygon Inversion (2)
Episodes.Description: With UNIT neutralised, only the Doctor stands in the way of the Zygons.

Episodes.Title: Sleep No More
Episodes.Description: This terrifying story is assembled from footage discovered in the wreckage of Le Verrier Space Station.

Episodes.Title: Face the Raven
Episodes.Description: The Doctor and Clara, with their old friend Rigsy, find themselves in a magical alien world, hidden on a street in the heart of London.

Episodes.Title: Heaven Sent (1)
Episodes.Description: Trapped in a world unlike any other he has seen, the Doctor faces the greatest challenge of his many lives. One final test. And he must face it alone.

Episodes.Title: Hell Bent (2)
Episodes.Description: If you took everything from him, betrayed him, trapped him, and broke both his hearts...how far might the Doctor go?

Episodes.Title: The Pilot
Episodes.Description: Two worlds collide when the Doctor meets Bill. A chance encounter with a girl with a star in her eye leads to a terrifying chase across time and space. Bill’s mind is opened to a universe that is bigger and more exciting than she could possibly have imagined – but who is the Doctor, and what is his secret mission with Nardole on Earth?

Episodes.Title: Smile
Episodes.Description: The language of the future is emoji! The Doctor takes Bill to a spectacular city on a distant planet - but where are the colonists? A band of 'cute' droids hold the deadly answer.

Episodes.Title: Thin Ice
Episodes.Description: London, 1814. The entire city has turned out for the biggest Frost Fair in decades. But beneath the frozen Thames, revellers are disappearing, snatched through the ice and pulled into the depths where a terrifying monster lurks. Will the Doctor and Bill stop the slaughter before they too are dragged into the icy waters?

Episodes.Title: Knock Knock
Episodes.Description: Why do floorboards creak? When a sinister landlord shows Bill and her friends the perfect houseshare, they have no idea what lies ahead... knock knock, who's there?

Episodes.Title: Oxygen
Episodes.Description: “Space - the final frontier. Final because it wants to kill us.” Trapped on a space station with no oxygen, the Doctor, Bill and Nardole are horrified to discover the automated spacesuits keeping them alive are also trying to kill them!

Episodes.Title: Extremis (1)
Episodes.Description: “The Veritas. The truth. Truth so true you can't live with it. Is that looking into hell... or seeing the light?” Everyone who has ever read the Veritas has been found dead. In a forbidden library at the heart of the Vatican, the pope urges the Doctor to read the ancient text - but can he handle the truth?

Episodes.Title: The Pyramid at the End of the World (2)
Episodes.Description: An “ancient” pyramid appears overnight. Every clock in the world begins counting down to the Earth's destruction. Three opposing armies lie ready to annihilate each other. An alien race stands ready to offer humanity a deal that could save them, but also enslave them. It's a terrifying race against time to save the world. Will the Doctor be forced to accept their help?

Episodes.Title: The Lie of the Land (3)
Episodes.Description: Earth has been invaded and Bill is living alone, an isolated figure surviving in occupied Britain. The Doctor is imprisoned and appears to be on the side of the enemy, flooding the airwaves with fake news. Bill and Nardole must embark on a deadly mission to rescue the Doctor and lead the resistance against the new regime, whatever the cost.

Episodes.Title: Empress of Mars
Episodes.Description: “God save the Queen” has been scrawled on the surface of Mars. What are Victorians doing on the home of the Ice Warriors? And what will they find beneath the Martian soil?

Episodes.Title: The Eaters of Light
Episodes.Description: A long time ago, the ninth legion of the Roman army vanished into the mists of Scotland. Bill has a theory about what happened, and the Doctor has a time machine. But when they arrive in ancient Aberdeenshire, what they find is a far greater threat than any army. In a cairn, on a hillside, is a doorway leading to the end of the world.

Episodes.Title: World Enough and Time (1)
Episodes.Description: Friendship drives the Doctor into the rashest decision of his life. Trapped on a giant spaceship, caught in the event horizon of a black hole, he witnesses the death of someone he is pledged to protect. Is there any way he can redeem his mistake? Are events already out of control? For once, time is the Time Lord’s enemy.

Episodes.Title: The Doctor Falls (2)
Episodes.Description: “Without hope, without witness, without reward.” The Mondasian Cybermen are on the rise. It’s time for the Doctor’s final battle…

Episodes.Title: The Woman Who Fell to Earth
Episodes.Description: “We don't get aliens in Sheffield.” In a South Yorkshire city, Ryan Sinclair, Yasmin Khan and Graham O'Brien are about to have their lives changed forever, as a mysterious woman, unable to remember her own name, falls from the night sky. Can they believe a word she says? And can she help solve the strange events taking place across the city?

Episodes.Title: The Ghost Monument
Episodes.Description: Still reeling from their first encounter, can the Doctor and her new friends stay alive long enough, in a hostile alien environment, to solve the mystery of Desolation? And just who are Angstrom and Epzo?

Episodes.Title: Rosa
Episodes.Description: Montgomery, Alabama. 1955. The Doctor and her friends find themselves in the Deep South of America. As they encounter a seamstress by the name of Rosa Parks, they begin to wonder whether someone is attempting to change history.

Episodes.Title: Arachnids in the UK
Episodes.Description: “Something's happening with the spiders in this city.” The Doctor, Yaz, Graham and Ryan find their way back to Yorkshire - and Yaz's family - only to find something is stirring amidst the eight-legged arachnid population of Sheffield.

Episodes.Title: The Tsuranga Conundrum
Episodes.Description: Injured and stranded in the wilds of a far-flung galaxy, the Doctor, Yaz, Graham and Ryan must band together with a group of strangers to survive against one of the universe's most deadly - and unusual - creatures.

Episodes.Title: Demons of the Punjab
Episodes.Description: India, 1947. The Doctor and her friends arrive in the Punjab, as India is being torn apart. While Yaz attempts to discover her grandmother's hidden history, the Doctor discovers demons haunting the land. Who are they, and what do they want?

Episodes.Title: Kerblam!
Episodes.Description: “Delivery for the Doctor!” A mysterious message arrives in a package addressed to the Doctor, leading her, Graham, Yaz and Ryan to investigate the warehouse moon orbiting Kandoka, and the home of the galaxy’s largest retailer: Kerblam!

Episodes.Title: The Witchfinders
Episodes.Description: The Doctor, Ryan, Graham and Yaz arrive in 17th-century Lancashire and become embroiled in a witch trial run by the local landowner. As fear stalks the land, the arrival of King James I only serves to intensify the witch hunt. But is there something even more dangerous at work? Can the Doctor and friends keep the people of Bilehurst Cragg safe from all the forces that are massing in the land?

Episodes.Title: It Takes You Away
Episodes.Description: On the edge of a Norwegian fjord in the present day, the Doctor, Ryan, Graham and Yaz discover a boarded-up cottage and a girl named Hanne in need of their help. What has happened here? What monster lurks in the woods around the cottage - and beyond?

Episodes.Title: The Battle of Ranskoor Av Kolos
Episodes.Description: On the planet of Ranskoor Av Kolos, a battlefield, a conflict-scarred survivor, and a deadly reckoning await the Doctor, Ryan, Yaz and Graham.

Episodes.Title: Spyfall (1)
Episodes.Description: When intelligence agents around the world come under attack from alien forces, MI6 turns to the only person who can help- a certain Doctor and her companions. As they travel the globe in pursuit of answers, threats arrive from all sides, leaving Earth’s security resting on the team’s shoulders. But where will this planet-threatening conspiracy lead them?

Episodes.Title: Spyfall (2)
Episodes.Description: In part two of this epic spy thriller, a terrifying plan to destroy humanity is about to reach fruition. Can the Doctor and her friends escape multiple traps and defeat a deadly alliance?

Episodes.Title: Orphan 55
Episodes.Description: The Doctor and her friends discover that the luxury resort where they are holidaying is hiding a number of deadly secrets. What are the ferocious monsters attacking Tranquillity Spa?

Episodes.Title: Nikola Tesla's Night of Terror
Episodes.Description: 1903. On the edge of Niagara Falls, something is wrong at Nikola Tesla’s generator plant. Who or what is sabotaging the maverick inventor’s work? Has he really received a message from Mars? And where does his great rival Thomas Edison fit into these events? The Doctor, Yaz, Ryan and Graham must join forces with one of history’s great minds to save both him and planet Earth.

Episodes.Title: Fugitive of the Judoon
Episodes.Description: Ko Sho Blo! Trigger-happy space police the Judoon are targeting 21st-century Gloucester. The Doctor, Yaz, Ryan and Graham race back to Earth in order to prevent them doing too much damage to the cathedral city. But who are they looking for, and what did they do to incur the wrath of the Judoon?

Episodes.Title: Praxeus
Episodes.Description: The mysterious “Praxeus” will cause the quartet to split up (never a good idea) to investigate mysteries all over Earth. And what they find will threaten all human life (again).

Episodes.Title: Can You Hear Me?
Episodes.Description: As Graham, Yaz and Ryan return home to see friends and family, they find themselves haunted by very different experiences. Who is the figure calling from beyond the stars for help, and why? And what are the fearsome Chagaskas terrorising Aleppo in 1380? To find the answers, Team TARDIS must embark on a mission which forces them to face their darkest fears.

Episodes.Title: The Haunting of Villa Diodati
Episodes.Description: Lake Geneva, 1816. Lord Byron and the Shelleys prepare for a night telling ghost stories, but their villa proves to have ghostly presences all its own.

Episodes.Title: Ascension of the Cybermen (1)
Episodes.Description: In the far future, the Doctor and her friends face a brutal battle across the farthest reaches of space to protect the last of the human race against the deadly Cybermen.

Episodes.Title: The Timeless Children (2)
Episodes.Description: The Cybermen are on the march. The last remaining humans are hunted down. Lies are exposed, truths are revealed, and for the Doctor nothing will ever be the same.

Episodes.Title: The Halloween Apocalypse
Episodes.Description: On Halloween, all across the universe, terrifying forces are stirring. The life of Dan Lewis is about to change forever. Why is the Doctor chasing Karvanista? What is the Flux?

Episodes.Title: War of the Sontarans
Episodes.Description: In the Crimean War, the Doctor discovers the British army fighting a brutal alien army of Sontarans, as Yaz and Dan are thrown deeper into a battle for survival. What is the Temple of Atropos? Who are the Mouri?

Episodes.Title: Once, Upon Time
Episodes.Description: 'Time is beginning to run wild.' On a planet that shouldn’t exist, in the aftermath of apocalypse, the Doctor, Dan, Yaz and Vinder face a battle to survive.

Episodes.Title: Village of the Angels
Episodes.Description: Devon, November 1967. A little girl has gone missing, Professor Eustacius Jericho is conducting psychic experiments, and in the village graveyard, there is one gravestone too many. Why is Medderton known as the Cursed Village, and what do the Weeping Angels want?

Episodes.Title: Survivors of the Flux
Episodes.Description: As the forces of evil mass, the Doctor, Yaz and Dan face perilous journeys and seemingly insurmountable obstacles in their quest for survival.

Episodes.Title: The Vanquishers
Episodes.Description: In the final epic chapter in the story of the Flux, all hope is lost. The forces of darkness are in control. But when the monsters have won, who can you count upon to save the universe?

Entries.Title: Ghost Doctor
Entries.Description: A skilled surgeon becomes a coma patient and possesses a first-year resident who is the polar opposite of him in expertise and personality.

Episodes.Title: The Finest Cardiothoracic Surgeon
Episodes.Description: Sensing that Ko Seung-tak, a resident at Eunsang University Medical Center, will not get along with him, Cha Young-min, the top cardiothoracic surgeon, plans to get rid of him.

Episodes.Title: A Coma Ghost
Episodes.Description: Young-min finds his body in a critical condition and gets confused about if he is alive or dead; Young-min discovers that he can possess Seung-tak only; a mysterious man calls Young-min a coma ghost.

Episodes.Title: A Well-Planned Coincidence
Episodes.Description: Young-min suspects Seung-tak for the car accident but reconsiders his opinions when Seung-tak makes a sacrifice for him; a VIP patient suffers side effects after the surgery.

Episodes.Title: You Want In Or Out?
Episodes.Description: With an emergency patient in front of him, Seung-tak struggles. At the same time, Young-min faces the risk of disappearing for good. The two become physically and mentally inseparable, but neither one seems to accept the situation. Meanwhile, Young-min finds out who the wrongdoer behind Chairman Jang’s case is and gets shocked.

Episodes.Title: Help Me Out Here!
Episodes.Description: Seung-tak has no other option but to ask Young-min for help in saving an emergency patient. While Young-min is impressed with his good faith, he is also shocked and realizes that there is a possibility that Seung-tak might be seeing him. But first things first, the two team up to save the patient.

Episodes.Title: The Ghost Patient
Episodes.Description: Young-min finds out from the ghost patient that the accident he was involved in was also planned out by someone. Meanwhile, Seung-jo begs Seung-tak to do whatever it takes to save him. However, the only doctor who can save Seung-jo is Young-min, and the only person who can connect the two is Seung-tak.

Episodes.Title: What It Means to Save Someone’s Life
Episodes.Description: Young-min is excited that he can save someone’s life again. At the same time, Seung-tak asks Young-min what it’s like to save a life all on your own. Meanwhile, someone special to Young-min visits the hospital, not as a guest but as a patient.

Episodes.Title: Sharing Secrets
Episodes.Description: Young-min reveals the truth about what happened to Seung-tak 12 years ago; Young-min's assailant regains consciousness but cannot remember anything.

Episodes.Title: Ghost Doctor
Episodes.Description: Se-jin feels Young-min's presence when interacting with Seung-tak; Seung-won finds Seung-tak's behaviour suspicious.

Episodes.Title: No Reason to Hide
Episodes.Description: Young-min, still in Seung-tak's body, decides to reveal himself to Seung-won; Seung-tak helps Young-min spend some time with Se-jin; something unexpected happens at the hospital.

Episodes.Title: The Weak Spot
Episodes.Description: Young-min feels helpless when the coordination with Seung-jo goes wrong during surgery. Knowing how frustrated Young-min is, Seung-tak looks for other ways to save him. Meanwhile, Se-jin tries to keep a distance from Seung-tak, and Seung-tak is bothered by her sudden change in attitude. After pushing Seung-tak away, Se-jin is alone, and that’s when Min-ho barges in.

Episodes.Title: The Conflict
Episodes.Description: Se-jin collapses due to overwork and takes a few days off; Se-jin warns Seung-tak to stay away from Young-min; Seung-won and Tae-hyun hatch another plot.

Episodes.Title: Anything but This
Episodes.Description: Seung-tak loses control during his surgery and disappears, leaving everyone at the hospital worried. Young-min learns about Seung-tak's history, and Se-jin's suspicion about Seung-tak grows.

Episodes.Title: Thank You Tes
Episodes.Description: The connection between Young-min, Seung-tak, and Tes is revealed; Seung-tak returns to the hospital, and Se-jin is surprised to see the new Seung-tak.

Episodes.Title: A Difficult Decision
Episodes.Description: Se-jin discovers Seung-tak's secret; Seung-tak learns that the surgery has a major side effect; Young-min intends to treat as many patients; Young-min must make a tough choice.

Episodes.Title: Life and Death
Episodes.Description: Seung-tak and Young-min get ready for Young-min’s surgery, but Young-min looks like he has a lot on his mind. Either way, this is going to be their last surgery together as one. After the surgery, everyone waits to see if Young-min recovers. However, not everyone wishes that he would wake up or remember what has happened in the past few months.

Entries.Title: My Only Love Song
Entries.Description: Song Soo-Jung is an arrogant pop star who believes not only that status and money can get you anywhere, but that it defines your worth. She accidentally falls into a time-slip portal and travels back in time to the Joseon era where she meets On-Dal, a man who loves money yet is generous to those without.

Episodes.Title: I Am Princess Pyeong-gang
Episodes.Description: The story of Princess Pyeong-gang is the basis for a historical drama that stars Song Su-jeong, a top celeb with a huge ego and a foul mouth.

Episodes.Title: I Know Who You Are
Episodes.Description: Talking with the man she meets in the jail cell, Su-jeong realizes something is amiss and checks her script about the tale of Princess Pyeong-gang.

Episodes.Title: That's Me, On Dal
Episodes.Description: On Dal lives for money. But no matter how hard he tries, he's always broke. Every night, he wishes upon a star for one big chance to make him rich.

Episodes.Title: You Have Reached Your Destination
Episodes.Description: Handling Su-jeong's temper is her manager, Byun Sam-yong. His efforts made her into a star, and because of him, she becomes Princess Pyeong-gang.

Episodes.Title: This Is Your Destiny
Episodes.Description: Princess Pyeong-gang is King Pyeong-won's only child. She loves to read, and in one book, she learns that a strange bird will come to take her away.

Episodes.Title: I Got You
Episodes.Description: Raised on her grandma's tough love, Su-jeong is a strong woman. Even for her, though, this world is a scary place. To "help" her through is On Dal.

Episodes.Title: Take My Hand
Episodes.Description: Mu-myeong, a person of lowly birth, does not speak. The only one who understood him was Princess Pyeong-gang. For her, he will even give up his life.

Episodes.Title: Now Traveling to Your Destination
Episodes.Description: Eldest son of the powerful Ko family, Il-yong is tyrannical and bigheaded. No woman meets his standards, but lately, he keeps hallucinating about one.

Episodes.Title: Recalculating
Episodes.Description: Six years after he first joined the historical drama team as a costume car, Boong-boong is on the verge of being scrapped. But now, he has a family.

Episodes.Title: Resetting Your Destination
Episodes.Description: From the tribal chief of mountain bandits, Princess Pyeong-gang learns of their tragic history. She also sells off her wedding gown to the chief.

Episodes.Title: Truth or DareTruth or Dare
Episodes.Description: Il-yong heads to On Dal's house. While the two are alone, Sam-yong tells Su-jeong that he thinks he has finally found the key to bring them home.

Episodes.Title: Don't Disappear
Episodes.Description: Sam-yong gets angry at Su-jeong. Finding Pyeong-gang alone by the river, On Dal approaches her and explains why he had asked her to stay by his side.

Episodes.Title: Completely Bewitched
Episodes.Description: While alone, King Pyeong-won takes out a sword with the mark of a crescent moon, which he received as a gift from On Dal's father 25 years ago.

Episodes.Title: Where Is … ?
Episodes.Description: Il-yong orders search parties to find the "crazy woman." While running away, Su-jeong suddenly remembers On Dal telling her not to go anywhere.

Episodes.Title: On Dal, the General
Episodes.Description: Swordsmen surround Su-jeong and Sam-yong. Pyeong-gang tells Mu-myeong to run away. On Dal asks his mother to go with him to his father's homeland.

Episodes.Title: Die by My Hand
Episodes.Description: While Pyeong-gang is asleep, Mu-myeong comes to her as if in a dream. On Dal tells Il-yong that the king has ordered him to enter the palace tomorrow.

Episodes.Title: Disappearing
Episodes.Description: In return for helping On Dal carry out a plan, the king wants him to wed the princess. A prized history book that was inside Boong-boong goes missing.

Episodes.Title: I Will Obey Your Order
Episodes.Description: The king tells Il-yong that the wedding is off, but he will find a suitable wife for Il-yong. However, Il-yong says that he will choose his own wife.

Episodes.Title: Arrived at Your Final Destination
Episodes.Description: Commanding On Dal to fight in the war, the king hands him a sword, which On Dal immediately recognizes. Sam-yong finds the GPS set to take him back.

Episodes.Title: My Only Love Song
Episodes.Description: Su-jeong and Sam-yong plead with Boong-boong to turn on again. They find the history book and anxiously open it up. On Dal embarks on a long journey.

Entries.Title: Bloodhounds
Entries.Description: Two young boxers band together with a benevolent moneylender to take down a ruthless loan shark who preys on the financially desperate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After a thrilling boxing match, Kim Gun-woo befriends Hong Woo-jin. Kim Myeong-gil's business ambitions come into focus, with dangerous tactics at play.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Gun-woo meets with Choi Tae-ho to remedy his mother's debt. Myeong-gil endures a humiliating meeting with Hong Min-beom and grows revengeful.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Gun-woo and Woo-jin figure out how to take down the scam ring. Myeong-gil gains the upper hand on Min-beom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After the group faces a close call, President Choi plans his own operation. But as their plans fall into place, the enemies stand in their way.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After narrowly escaping a threat, the group trains for what's coming — and President Choi and his men look to extract valuable information.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The group celebrates as they get ready for their next move. More exposed than ever before, Myeong-gil goes after President Choi and his guards.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: After an unthinkable setback, Gun-woo and Woo-jin resolve to come back with a vengeance — later partnering with an unlikely figure.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Galvanized by their duty to their loved ones, Gun-woo and Woo-jin tread forward to take down Myeong-gil — once and for all.

Entries.Title: Destined with You
Entries.Description: A lawyer bound by a centuries-old curse becomes entangled with a civil servant who holds the key to his freedom — igniting an unexpected romance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Faced with complaints and an accident, Lee Hong-jo investigates an ominous temple, coming up against the mysterious — and cursed — Jang Sin-yu.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Now in possession of the enigmatic box, Hong-jo finds that opening it is not as easy as it seems. Sin-yu later asks Hong-jo for a favor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Desperate for love, Hong-jo wonders if her spell was a success. Sin-yu later brings Hong-jo along on a trip for a spell of his own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Faced with a mix-up, Sin-yu asks Hong-jo to reverse a spell. After coming to Hong-jo's rescue, Sin-yu remembers a clear moment from the past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Sin-yu finds himself unable to resist the desires of his heart, but a third party complicates the matter. Hong-jo pursues a romantic interest of her own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Amid a budding love triangle, Sin-yu struggles to remember what happened with Hong-jo. A much-awaited reversal spell doesn't go as planned.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The love triangle intensifies as Sin-yu and Kwon Jae-gyeong vie for Hong-jo's attention. An unexpected person begins to make Hong-jo uncomfortable.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Hong-jo decides to put up boundaries with Sin-yu. But after she encounters an unsettling situation, he comes to her aid.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: While Hong-jo and Sin-yu both experience illnesses, a sinister plot forms in the dark. Later, they share a tender moment of connection, present and past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Sin-yu makes a decision after remembering his past, making things harder for Hong-jo. As everything falls into place, an evil plot goes into effect.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As Hong-jo and Sin-yu grow closer, news of their relationship spreads. But as unsavory information circulates in the midst, Hong-jo navigates a minefield.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Hong-jo experiences a vision after Sin-yu rescues her from a dangerous situation. Hong-jo discovers the true reason behind Sin-yu's worsening symptoms.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Upon realizing the truth about their history, Hong-jo takes distance from Sin-yu — until a frightening incident brings him closer to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: As Hong-jo navigates a devastating situation, her past life with Sin-yu comes to light. But just as the worst seems to be over, a threat remains.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Even with their relationship solidified, Hong-jo and Sin-yu meet resistance from his father. Hong-jo confronts Yoon Na-yeon about their past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Clued in on her next threat, Hong-jo goes head-to-head with her stalker. Hong-jo and Sin-yu make a momentous decision about their future.

Entries.Title: Death's Game
Entries.Description: At the brink of going to hell, Yee-jae must cycle through twelve separate lives and twelve separate deaths in this reincarnation drama.

Episodes.Title: Death
Episodes.Description: After enduring seven years of relentless job hunting and daily struggle, Yee-jae finally decides to end his own life. After death, he encounters a mysterious entity.

Episodes.Title: The Reason You're Going to Hell.
Episodes.Description: Yee-jae doesn't understand why he's being punished and protests as he continues to face Death's retribution.

Episodes.Title: Death Can't Take Anything Away.
Episodes.Description: As he continues to undergo Death's unpredictable trials, Yee-jae decides to take steps to prepare for his next life, unbeknownst to Death.

Episodes.Title: The Reason You're Afraid of Death.
Episodes.Description: Death mocks humans, asserting that they desperately struggle to live only after they have died. In this life, Yee-jae reunites with someone he's missed dearly.

Episodes.Title: It Is Impossible to Break Free and Fight against Death.
Episodes.Description: Death warns that it will intervene if Yee-jae ever attempts to kill someone, but Yee-jae dismisses the warning as he prepares his revenge.

Episodes.Title: Memory
Episodes.Description: Yee-jae plans to accomplish what the world has failed to do, while Tae-u begins his counterattack.

Episodes.Title: Opportunity
Episodes.Description: Yee-jae realizes that no matter how many times he's reborn, it's meaningless if he doesn't live as himself.

Episodes.Title: Don't Go Looking For Death. Death Will Come Find You.
Episodes.Description: Just one final bullet remains. Will Yee-jae be able to evade death and survive?

Entries.Title: The Worst of Evil
Entries.Description: Set in the 1980s, a husband and wife, both detectives, infiltrate a massive criminal organization responsible for the illegal drug trade between Korea, China, and Japan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Detective Jun-mo goes undercover within Gangnam Union to probe an international drug trade.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Barely passing Gi-cheul's test, Jun-mo joins Gangnam Union and discovers an unexpected truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Eui-jeong's appearance puts the squad in trouble. Gi-cheul finds last night's attack suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The team seeks Eui-jeong's aid to assist Jun-mo in a crisis, which leads to a perilous love triangle.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Earning Gi-cheul's trust, Jun-mo becomes anxious as he sees Gi-cheul making a move towards Eui-jeong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The delivery accident jeopardizes the trade. Detective Hwang closely surveils Gangnam Union.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Hae-ryun shows interest in Jun-mo and Eui-jeong approaches Gi-cheul. Jun-mo takes an extreme measure.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Gi-cheul suspects Jun-mo. The four people's irreversible decisions trigger the biggest crisis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: The battle with Jae-geon creates a crack. Jun-mo joins forces with Hae-ryun to resume the trade.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Jun-mo and Eui-jeong juggle duty and feelings. Hwang continues to meddle, and the final day arrives.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: An accident halts the trade and a crisis approaches as Eui-jeong and Do-hyung worry about Jun-mo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Gi-cheul and Jun-mo make their way to the final deal. Korea, China, and Japan prepare for the arrest.

Entries.Title: Strong Girl Nam-soon
Entries.Description: Gifted with superhuman strength, a young woman returns to Korea to find her birth family — only to be entangled in a drug case that could test her power.

Episodes.Title: Birth of the Strong Girl
Episodes.Description: Desperate for a reunion, Hwang Geum-ju seemingly finds her long-lost daughter. After discovering the truth, Gang Nam-soon prepares for her trip to Korea.

Episodes.Title: Gangnam, Here I Come
Episodes.Description: Nam-soon begins her search for her parents in Korea but experiences some roadblocks. Geum-ju suspects something's off with her newfound daughter.

Episodes.Title: Three Generations
Episodes.Description: The incident at the Han River puts a spotlight on Nam-soon. As Kang Hee-sik spends more time with Nam-soon, he connects the dots about her family.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: After a dramatic reunion, Nam-soon becomes closer to her family. As Hee-sik continues to investigate a drug case, Nam-soon lends her assistance.

Episodes.Title: Vigilante of Seoul
Episodes.Description: As Nam-soon assists Hee-sik in his drug investigation, she has a run-in with the ominous Ryu Si-o. Ri Hwa-ja plots her revenge against Nam-soon.

Episodes.Title: Mystery X
Episodes.Description: Hee-sik witnesses the jarring effects of the drug when it strikes his team leader. Nam-soon's search for evidence garners attention from foes.

Episodes.Title: Moonbow
Episodes.Description: Geum-ju pays a strategic visit to Si-o, who has his own motives. During a birthday dinner, Nam-soon's family questions her growing kinship with Hee-sik.

Episodes.Title: Light and Shadow of Gangnam
Episodes.Description: Hee-sik begins to worry about Nam-soon after Si-o promotes her into his inner circle. Geum-ju probes deeper into a suspicious businessman.

Episodes.Title: The Root of Vice
Episodes.Description: Nam-soon pulls off a bold heist, putting Si-o on high alert. During a tense meeting, Geum-ju challenges Si-o — who in return begins plotting his revenge.

Episodes.Title: The Stand-ins
Episodes.Description: Geum-ju falls victim to Si-o's attack but proves she's one step ahead of him. As Nam-soon finally tracks down the drugs, her brother succumbs to them.

Episodes.Title: Breaking Point
Episodes.Description: The drug infiltrates Nam-soon's family — prompting a search of the source and an antidote. A mourning Hee-sik furiously goes after Si-o's inner circle.

Episodes.Title: Diamond Cuts Diamond
Episodes.Description: Si-o learns of Geum-ju's ruse and decides to expand his target. As the drug case becomes more intense, Hee-sik asks Nam-soon to move in with him.

Episodes.Title: Save the Sea Hares
Episodes.Description: To find out Nam-soon's identity, Si-o narrows down his search and goes after her family. Hee-sik faces harsh discipline after news of the drug goes wide.

Episodes.Title: Forewarned Bloodbath
Episodes.Description: Si-o vows revenge after discovering the truth about Nam-soon. While Hee-sik continues his investigation, Nam-soon and her family go on a trip to Busan.

Episodes.Title: Strong Girl Nam-soon
Episodes.Description: Mourning the loss of Hwa-ja, Nam-soon directly challenges Si-o. But he refuses to lose, forcing her to endure incredible pain to save her adopted mother.

Episodes.Title: In the Name of Love and Justice
Episodes.Description: With Nam-soon on the brink of death — Hee-sik rushes to find an antidote. Nam-soon faces Si-o once again but witnesses a surprising turn.

Entries.Title: Vigilante
Entries.Description: Kim Ji-yong leads a double life as a Korean National Police University student by day and the Vigilante by night, personally punishing criminals who evade the law. He is surrounded by people who all possess different ulterior motives.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Kim Ji-yong loses his mother to a gangster and begins punishing criminals who evade the law.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Choi Mi-ryeo baits the Vigilante with more information on criminals on REPO25h.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Copycat crimes emerge nationwide, and Jo Heon and Choi Mi-ryeo chase after the Vigilante.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The fake Vigilante suggests joining forces, and Jo Heon closes in on the Vigilante's identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Mi-ryeo reports on Se-wool's alleged crimes, and Kim Ji-yong and Jo Heon come into conflict.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Ji-yong and Gang-ok help Mi-ryeo continue digging into Kim Sam-doo and the Vole.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The Vole tries to bury the case by sacrificing Kim Samdoo, but Samdoo retaliates with all he has.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Kim Jiyong gathers everyone involved in one location, and the final battle begins.

Entries.Title: The Escape of the Seven
Entries.Description: The mysterious disappearance of a girl brings together seven people from all different walks of life. They all have an intertwined connection to her disappearance in the most horrific, unfathomable, and despicable way. As money drives them to their greed, lies, and delirium, they face divine retribution as they struggle for their lives in a picturesque revenge. How far will they go to claim their innocence, and will anyone make it out alive?

Episodes.Title: Da-Mi Leaves with Her Mother
Episodes.Description: Da-mi, a young high school student with a heart condition, leaves her adoptive parents to live with Geum Ra-hui, her biological mother. When Da-mi arrives at Ra-hui's place, she is overwhelmed by her riches. However, she soon starts to wonder if her mother's intentions are genuine after an incident with her affluent grandfather.

Episodes.Title: The Bobble Incident
Episodes.Description: After a humiliating incident at her new school, Da-mi faints in front of Chil-sung's house. Meanwhile, Mo-ne attracts the attention of multiple entertainment agencies after a stunning audition, including La-hui. However, a rumor surfaces online that could potentially destroy everything she has worked for.

Episodes.Title: Da-mi Leaves La-hui
Episodes.Description: Da Mi leaves La Hui and promises she won't let her receive any money from her grandfather. Meanwhile, Scarlet Letter spreads rumors of Da Mi and her stepfather's promiscuous relationship, causing widespread outrage and chaos. To make things right, Da Mi takes things into her own hands and calls everyone to the park.

Episodes.Title: Da-mi Disappears
Episodes.Description: Da Mi disappears as she broadcasts getting shot live over the Internet, and the person taking the fall is her adoptive father, Lee Hwi So. The people involved get entangled in twisted turmoil while the police search for Da Mi's body. Meanwhile, Bang Chil Sung steps in to find the truth.

Episodes.Title: Party on Jeju Island with Mo-Ne
Episodes.Description: Lee Hwi So gets the death sentence for the murder of Da Mi and Chil Sung. Miraculously, Bang Chil Sung survives the fall and works with Kang Ki Tak to secretly help Hwi So get out of prison so he can avenge Da Mi's death. Meanwhile, Mone becomes a huge star and prepares a special party on Jeju Island to which only thirty-three winners are invited.

Episodes.Title: The Remaining Seven
Episodes.Description: After encountering peril and beating death, the seven people who managed to escape the island alive struggle to stay out of facing trouble with the law. However, all seven of them find a threatening message in their room that shocks them. Meanwhile, Matthew Lee appears just in the nick of time to help the seven survivors with the police investigation.

Episodes.Title: The Gathering of the Seven
Episodes.Description: After learning that Nam Chul-woo was the detective in Da-mi's murder, La-hui senses something out of place and gets Jin-mo to check on Lee Hwi-so. Meanwhile, Mo-ne's guilty conscience haunts her while her relationship with La-hui deteriorates. Later, Matthew gathers the seven survivors and watches them struggle and blame each other for their survival.

Episodes.Title: Chairman Bang's Demise
Episodes.Description: After another death to cover up the incident on the island occurs, Matthew determines to use the Seven to find the mastermind behind it all. Meanwhile, another suspicious letter arrives to each of the Seven with their darkest secrets, causing chaos within the group. They come together to form a plan and go after Chairman Bang, who they learn is still alive.

Episodes.Title: Matthew's Party with the Seven
Episodes.Description: After the TIKITAKA Signing and Inauguration, Matthew hosts a party to celebrate and invites those seven survivors to his home. Meanwhile, Matthew manages to bring Mo-ne's family back to Seoul, and Ji-a threatens Mo-ne about Sim Jun-seok.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Secrets
Episodes.Description: The seven criminals find Ji-a's dead body at her place and straight away realize K is behind it. While they are in panic, Jin-mo gets a phone call from K. Meanwhile, Matthew decides to take everything away from those seven criminals and reveal their crimes to the public, one by one.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Pawns
Episodes.Description: The seven people find out Matthew is Hwi-so, and Do-hyuk has been helping him all this time. He plans to use the seven people as his pawns to fight K and Sungchan Group. He lets them choose whether to die in K's hands or gain the chance to make amends by standing on his side.

Episodes.Title: Matthew Suspects Ki-tak
Episodes.Description: Chairman Sim of Sungchan Group notices TIKITAKA has been challenging him from the beginning. Chairman Sim looks into Matthew and Do-hyuk to fight them back. Meanwhile, Matthew and Do-hyuk are suspicious of Ki-tak and are confused about which side he is on.

Episodes.Title: The Revelations
Episodes.Description: Do-hyuk thinks Ki-tak betrayed him and Matthew without realizing that Matthew was behind everything. Matthew lies to Do-hyuk that Ki-tak is dead when, in fact, he was holding Ki-tak captive. Matthew, who revealed himself as K to Ki-tak, tortures Ki-tak to find out where Chairman Bang’s money is. Meanwhile, Jin-mo reveals to Matthew that K’s child is alive.

Episodes.Title: The New Mission
Episodes.Description: Matthew threatens Jin-mo that he’ll kill Paeng-hee if Do-hyuk ever finds out that he’s K. Do-hyuk barges into Sungchan to find out where Ki-tak went, and he ends up hurting Mo-ne who was there to see the chairman Sim. Meanwhile, another mission is given to them, and this time, they must steal the paintings from Sungchan Gallery.

Episodes.Title: The Intruder
Episodes.Description: Mone helps Do Hyuk escape while he’s being chased by the police, and they run away together. Do Hyuk finds out the identity of K and infiltrates the TIKITAKA building to get him. La Hui accidentally finds where Lee Hwi So is. Meanwhile, Chairman Sim decides to use Do Hyuk and blame him for all the crimes.

Episodes.Title: Trust No One
Episodes.Description: Chairman Sim and Min Do Hyuk’s paternity test results shock the entire nation. Matthew goes to Chairman Sim’s house and lures Do Hyuk there. Chairman Sim throws himself in front of Do Hyuk to stop Matthew from killing him. Cha Ju Ran and Nam Chul Woo manage to break into Chairman Bang’s vault and find his money.

Episodes.Title: The Last Escape
Episodes.Description: Chairman Sim holds a press conference and reveals the truth about Sim Jun Seok. La Hui plans to team up with Ju Ran in order to get away with the life-or-death situation. Meanwhile, K finds out Do Hyuk's hideout through Mone and creates the last escape game just for the seven sinners.

Episodes.Title: Min Do Hyuk Returns
Episodes.Description: The six that held hands with K, the absolute evil, for survival at the crossroads of good and evil live lavish lives in return for Min Do Hyuk's betrayal. However, they are slaves to K and have lost their freedom. Meanwhile, Min Do Hyuk opens his eyes out of a coma he fell into from the explosion he suffered on the rooftop.

Episodes.Title: The Preview of “Dear D”
Episodes.Description: Matthew promotes TIKITAKA's new missing children application, Children Home. During the campaign, Myoung Ji's daughter, Erica, gets abducted. Meanwhile, the movie preview is just around the corner, and Monet worries that the mistakes she made in her life will get exposed to the world. Although she tries to stop the preview from showing, the preview event opens its doors.

Episodes.Title: Do Hyuk Reveals His Face
Episodes.Description: Min Do Hyuk removes his mask and shows himself to Sim Jun Seok, who can't believe he is alive. He is furious that Do Hyuk's trickery got him to clear the charges against him, and he gathers everyone to uncover the traitor. However, Do Hyuk makes his move by winning the hearts of the public, who go crazy over him and his story.

Episodes.Title: Mo Ne’s Will to Survive
Episodes.Description: After rescuing No Han Na, Min Do Hyuk's plan to ensure her safety has Matthew scrambling to find her. The whole country watches as the remaining time runs out. Matthew accuses Mone of working with Min Do Hyuk but gives her a chance to prove her life is worth keeping. Meanwhile, Hwang Chan Sung watches Mone closely with a helping hand.

Episodes.Title: Do Hyuk Gains Access to LUCA
Episodes.Description: At Mone and Chan Sung's engagement party, Matthew tries to get close to Chan Sung, but Chan Sung shuts him down. With Chan Sung at her back, Mone exposes how La Hui and Matthew had kept their eyes on her. Meanwhile, Do Hyuk and Ki Tak break into Matthew's secret room and access LUCA to gain critical data for their next attack.

Episodes.Title: Chan Sung’s True Identity
Episodes.Description: La Hui risks getting exposed and stops Matthew from killing Do Hyuk and Ki Tak. Matthew believes Chan Sung is Medusa and puts Mone on her second mission. Meanwhile, Chan Sung reveals himself as Medusa to Do Hyuk and asks him to join hands against Matthew. However, Do Hyuk senses something isn't right.

Episodes.Title: Medusa Gets Exposed
Episodes.Description: Geum La Hui takes matters into her own hands after getting revealed as Medusa. She begins to trap those involved in Da Mi's death one by one, and ultimately herself, to be judged and punished. Meanwhile, Min Do Hyuk continues to help Mone, which disturbs Chan Sung.

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: After leaving a letter for Ki Tak, Geum La Hui starts the game of survival that she plans to broadcast live over Save's network. However, Chan Sung has plans of his own and takes advantage. Meanwhile, Ki Tak races to stop La Hui and save Do Hyuk after he reads La Hui's letter of regret.

Episodes.Title: Who Will Be the Mayor ?
Episodes.Description: The Seoul mayor by-elections are nearing, but Yang Jin Mo trails behind in his campaign. Luckily, Hwang Chan Sung lends his help for something in return. Meanwhile, Mo Ne succumbs to Chan Sung to locate her mother, who she thought was dead, and Do Hyuk reclaims Sungchan Group to take on TIKITAKA and Save.

Episodes.Title: Manipulated Algorithms
Episodes.Description: After the wedding, Mo Ne can't believe what she discovers at Chan Sung's house and hopes she can save her mother. However, she can only succumb to Chan Sung's demands and rely on Min Hyuk with a plan. With Han Na in Chan Sung's hands, Jin Mo seeks help from Min Hyuk and twists Matthew's plans. Meanwhile, Min Hyuk uses Ju Ran and Chul Woo to turn Matthew and Chan Sung against each other.

Episodes.Title: Myoung Ji's Last Wish
Episodes.Description: After getting shot by Matthew, Go Myoung Ji struggles to hang on to her life with Jin Mo and the rest of the people by her side. Meanwhile, Matthew finds a way to escape police custody with Chan Sung's help and tries to manipulate the public in his favour. Later, Do Hyuk and the rest commit to a press conference to expose their sins and corner Matthew.

Episodes.Title: The New Chairman of Sungchan Group
Episodes.Description: Matthew tries to stop Min Do Hyuk's press conference, but it's too late. However, he doesn't give up. Meanwhile, the reporters agree to reveal the evil deeds that stemmed from the Bobble incident and promise to expose Matthew's true identity. Later, Min Do Hyuk becomes Sungchan Group's chairman and reveals himself as Chairman Sim's biological heir.

Episodes.Title: Is Matthew Lee, Lee Hwi So ?
Episodes.Description: Do Hyuk pushes forward with his plans to expose Matthew and starts by releasing S-CURI, an app that safeguards users' secret chats from being spied on. Matthew pours all his effort and money into proving his identity as Lee Hwi So. Meanwhile, Mone works with Do Hyuk to turn Chan Sung against Matthew.

Episodes.Title: Yang Jin Mo’s Demise
Episodes.Description: Yang Jin Mo dies. He leaves his heart for Go Myoung Ji and saves her life. Matthew uses his power and connections to make Min Do Hyuk look like Yang Jin Mo's murderer. Meanwhile, Min Do Hyuk comes up with a new plan, and Han Mo Ne is there to help him.

Episodes.Title: Matthew Destroys Do Hyuk’s Plans
Episodes.Description: Despite Mo Ne's involvement in Da Mi's death, Ki Tak saves her from Chan Sung's wrath and keeps her out of harm's way. However, Ki Tak gets taken hostage by Matthew as she makes her getaway. Upon discovery of Chan Sung's murder, Matthew gets the upper hand by framing Do Hyuk as the murderer and destroys his plan. Meanwhile, Myoung Ji recovers and plots her revenge.

Episodes.Title: The Final Battle
Episodes.Description: Min Do Hyuk corners Matthew and exposes the truth behind all his evil deeds in front of the press as his final blow. With no way to escape the accusations, Matthew takes matters into his own hands, creating carnage. Meanwhile, Mo Ne turns herself in as Chan Sung's murderer, and the prosecution goes after Matthew.

Entries.Title: My Dearest
Entries.Description: A love-story between a noblewoman and a mysterious man who shows up in her hometown set in the 1600s during the Qing invasion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A stranger enters Neunggun-ri, a peaceful village where Gil-chae lives, and turns the village upside down.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Gil-chae gets help from Jang-hyun to learn about people in Hanyang, and he takes her to interesting places.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Yeon-jun and the scholars volunteer to fight for the country, while Jang-hyun plans to evacuate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: When Gil-сhae and Eun-фe are about to flee from their village, the intruders arrive at Neunggun-ri.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Jang-hyun helps Yeon-jun as he gets injured. Meanwhile, the Crown Prince wants to ask Jang-hyun for help.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Since the King of Joseon does not come out from the fortress, Khan conquers Ganghwa Island.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Yeon-jun is about to propose to Eun-ae. Yeon-jun and Gil-chae have a private chat for the last time.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Jang-hyun and his friends leave Joseon with the Crown Prince and meet Yong Gol-dae in Simyang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Jang-hyun captures fleeing prisoners in Simyang, while Gil-chae runs a business to make a living.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Jang-hyun returns to Joseon and finds out Gil-chae is engaged to another man.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: While capturing fleeing prisoners from Joseon, Jang-hyun meets familiar people.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Gil-chae and Jong-jong get captured and dragged to Qing while trying to help Da-jim.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Won-moo travels to Simyang to bring Gil-chae back. Jang-hyun meets the princess of the Qing in Simyang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Jang Hyun meets Gil-chae at the slave market in Simyang and saves her from the merchant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Gil-chae stays in Simyang until Jang-hyun gets better, but Ryang-eum wants her gone as soon as possible.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Gil-chae wants to stay in Simyang, but Jang-hyun sends her back to Joseon for her safety.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Jang-hyun returns to Joseon with the Crown Prince, and the King is afraid his son will take over his place.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: The King of Joseon banned the Crown Prince from bringing back the captives to Joseon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Gil-chae secretly takes Jang-hyun home, and the eunuchs from the palace are searching everywhere to find him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Jang-hyun finds out the Crown Prince left a letter for him. Gak-hwa looks for Jang-hyun at Gil-chae's house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: As His Majesty's men hunt down the captives on the run, Jang-hyun sends Gil-chae away and turns to face them.

Entries.Title: Weak Hero
Entries.Description: With the aid of unexpected friends, a gifted but introverted student confronts bullies and violent foes — unaware of how dangerous his world will become.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Si-eun is a model student who is always at the top of his school. Because he only cares about his studies, he has no friends at school. Young-bin, a boy in Si-eun's class, is annoyed by Si-eun's cynical attitude. On a mock test day, Young-bin decides to use Bum-seok, a new student, to mess with Si-eun's test.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Young-bin wants revenge on Si-eun for putting him in the hospital by hiring a couple of thugs he knows. Meanwhile, Si-eun gets closer to Soo-ho and becomes friends. Later, Soo-ho comes to Si-eun's rescue when he gets confronted by Young-bin and his thugs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: When Gil-su sees his boys beaten up to a pulp, he gets furious and asks who did it. Young-bin lures Si-eun, Bum-seok, and Soo-ho and takes them to Gil-su. Gil-su threatens them to bring him 15 million won in three days. Si-eun asks Young for advice and information on Gil-su.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Si-eun sees Soo-ho's blood on the floor and calls Young-yi for help. Gil-su tells Seok-dae to come, so Young-yi follows him with her GPS tracking app on. Meanwhile, Soo-ho and Bum-seok are tied up by Gil-su's gang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: While hanging out in a karaoke room with his friends, Bum-seok runs into the bullies from his previous school. Soo-ho makes them apologize, but Bum-seok isn't happy with Soo-ho ordering him around. Si-eun becomes more worried about Bum-seok who seems to be getting more unstable.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Bum-seok befriends with Jeong-chan and Tae-hoon, he reeks of alcohol every day. Si-eun thinks Bum-seok is being used by Jeong-chan and Tae-hoon. He also thinks Bum-seok is behaving that way because he is lonely. Si-eun wants to help Bum-seok, but Soo-ho thinks he's done enough. Meanwhile, Bum-seok pays Woo-young to beat Soo-ho on his birthday.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Si-eun gets beaten up by the guys Bum-seok paid to beat up Soo-ho. Si-eun gets seriously injured, but he doesn't tell Soo-ho about it to protect Bum-seok. Soo-ho finds out later and decides to confront Bum-seok. Bum-seok pays Woo-young again to beat up Soo-ho.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Si-eun and Young-yi get anxious as they can't get hold of Soo-ho for too long. After Si-eun finishes his exams, he hears the shocking news. Meanwhile, Bum-seok's dad tries to make Bum-seok go study abroad.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Still affected by what happened to Su-ho, Si-eun withdraws from others. Seo Jun-tae contemplates taking a stand against the bullies — despite the risks.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After being saved by Si-eun, Jun-tae attempts to befriend him — but both are soon dragged into Choi Hyo-man's revenge plot involving Go Hyun-tak.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: While doing volunteer work as punishment for fighting, Si-eun begins to form a bond with new friends — but trouble continues to find him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After Geum Seong-je crosses the line, Si-eun strikes a deal with Na Baek-jin — leaving Park Hu-min, Hyun-tak and Jun-tae alone in the violent crosshairs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Worried for his father and backed into a corner, Hu-min confronts Baek-jin. Si-eun considers studying abroad after clashing with his distressed mother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Si-eun, Jun-tae, and Hyun-tak seek out Hu-min, who has decided to work with Baek-jin to keep the peace. Still, Hu-min finds it difficult to comply.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: As Si-eun's absence leaves a gap, Baek-jin presses on with his violent mission. In response, Hu-min rallies his school and challenges him to a showdown.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Hu-min, Hyun-tak and Eunjang students gather to engage in a final confrontation against Baek-jin's gang. In the end, who will prevail?

Entries.Title: Alchemy of Souls
Entries.Description: A powerful sorceress in a blind woman's body encounters a man from a prestigious family, who wants her help to change his destiny.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Naksu casts one last spell to save her soul. Jang Uk looks for the only sorcerer who would dare to help him. Mu-deok gets taken under a new master.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: When Mu-deok refuses Uk's proposal to form an alliance, he convinces her in other ways. Park Jin barricades Songrim to catch a spy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Mu-deok sets the terms before beginning proper training. Uk discovers that Heo Yeom left him with a gift he must learn to claim as his own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Uk suffers a fever and chills, much to Mu-deok's delight. The Crown Prince visits the Jang household, demanding a family heirloom and a show of respect.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Mu-deok and Uk arrive at a secluded, empty cabin. Jin Mu orders a body dump. Jin Ho-gyeong offers protection for Uk... at a cost.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Seo Yul and Park Dang-gu visit Uk at his training ground. Mu-deok pushes her student to the extreme. Jin Cho-yeon prepares a wedding gift.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The Prince encounters an illusion. Uk demands entry into Jinyowon. Gil-ju goes after Naksu to acquire a body.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Gil-ju stumbles into town to satisfy his hunger. Uk follows closely behind him. Rumors surface of Naksu’s comeback.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Jin Ho-gyeong looks for her long-lost child. Jin Mu devises a plan to help end that search. Uk and Mu-deok are driven apart.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Uk is given a book to read. Yul saves a girl at the market. Mu-deok goes through an intensive selection process to become a servant at Songrim.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Uk loses the will to train. Mu-deok makes a bet with the Prince. At Cheonbugwan, a line of blind girls await judgment.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: An unusual death draws Park Jin’s attention. Uk learns of Naksu’s tragic past. Maid Kim sends Mu-deok on an errand to Cheonbugwan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: A sudden lightning strike causes damage to Cheonbugwan. Park Jin and Jin Mu dispute who's to blame. Master Lee takes Uk on a special fishing trip.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Uk faces his tenth and final opponent with a trick or two up his sleeve. Seo Yul keeps Mu-deok close. Jin U-tak plays a trick on his daughter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Mu-deok is caught at the site of a bloody murder. Master Lee presents the royal family with a gift and a prophecy. So-i tracks down a blind friend.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Park Jin and Jin Ho-gyeong get into a heated dispute as they both lay claim to an artifact. Uk runs into the Prince while on the search for a shaman.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Mu-deok investigates Jin Bu-yeon’s true identity. Jin Mu convinces Jin Ho-gyeong to make a special announcement at an important assembly.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Trapped inside an enchanted force field, Mu-deok explores her newfound powers but soon learns of its drawbacks. So-i makes a deal with a soul shifter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Uk comes up with a solution to break the force field that would require him to risk it all. Dang-gu and Cho-yeon make a startling discovery.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Love is in the air with a wedding on the way and Uk playing matchmaker. Jin Mu appoints an assassin to do his dirty work and become his scapegoat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A search leads Uk into Jinyowon, where he runs into a mysterious woman who is planning an escape. Meanwhile, haunting visions of the dead trouble him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Jin Ho-gyeong makes a family secret public. Jin Bu-yeon finds new shelter but realizes that her freedom is limited and time is running out.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: A debate surrounding a secret wedding ends with a shocking announcement. Jin Ho-gyeong tries to summon Bu-yeon back by causing her excruciating pain.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Flashes of another's memory leads Bu-yeon to find out more about Uk's past heartbreak. News of a feared assassin's return shakes the whole kingdom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Yul uncovers the mystery of his ill health as So-i becomes desperate to save him. Uk and Bu-yeon continue to hit barriers in their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: While Yul bears the burden of a heavy secret, Uk investigates a conspiracy involving a mysterious animal that could cause a devastating drought.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: To save a fatally injured mage, Uk gives Jin Mu a firm warning and asks Jin Ho-gyeong for help, who agrees to cooperate under one condition.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Go Won presents Uk with a choice. Jin Mu sets the next step of his plan in motion. Heo Yun-ok requests to meet Bu-yeon in private.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: As the search for the ice stone continues, Uk reaffirms his alliances while Jin Mu prepares for battle with an army of loyal soul shifters.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Jin Ho-gyeong takes a risk to protect Jinyowon and its treasures from attack. Having had a glimpse into the future, Uk braces for the inevitable.

Entries.Title: All of Us Are Dead
Entries.Description: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out — or turn into one of the rabid infected.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Inside Lee Byeong-chan's science lab, a student incurs a seemingly harmless bite. Shortly after, a fast-spreading outbreak soaks the school in blood.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The infected multiply in droves. Scrambling for their lives, Nam On-jo and Lee Cheong-san find safety with others inside a classroom — but not for long.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: When one of the group is scratched while fighting a zombie, Lee Na-yeon demands they kick him out. Outside, the virus swallows up the city.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: In need of a cellphone, two students take a risky journey to the teachers' office. Byeong-chan passes on critical information to Detective Song Jae-ik.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Martial law is imposed on the city. When Cheong-san is separated from the rest of the group, On-jo leads a mission to use a drone to locate him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The group clears a path to Cheong-san using sound to draw away zombies, but a new type of threat surfaces. Nam So-ju breaks out of the quarantine camp.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: To make it out of the music room and onto the roof, the students put into action their most perilous plan yet. Elsewhere, Jae-ik comes across a setback.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Jae-ik and his crew run into a student from the school. Na-yeon works up the courage to face her peers. The group shares confessions around a fire.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: A disturbance at the camp shifts the military's understanding of the virus. A thunderstorm provides cover as the group agrees to keep on moving.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
