Episodes.Description: The auditorium quickly becomes a trap for the two newly united teams of survivors. Byeong-chan's video logs reveal a drastic solution to the crisis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Though a surprise protector provides the group safe passage to their next stop, Yoon Gwi-nam is not far behind. The military makes a grave decision.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: The students make it to the quarantine camp, each of them weighed down by tragic loss. Months later, they hang on to hope for a survivor.

Entries.Title: Business Proposal
Entries.Description: In disguise as her friend, Ha-ri shows up to a blind date to scare him away. But plans go awry when he turns out to be her CEO — and makes a proposal.

Episodes.Title: Let's do it together, get married
Episodes.Description: To appease his grandfather's wishes, Kang Tae-moo agrees to a blind date. Jin Young-seo enlists Shin Ha-ri's help to scare away her latest prospect.

Episodes.Title: Fall in love with me
Episodes.Description: Tae-moo lies about having a girlfriend to stop the endless barrage of blind dates, with the perfect person in mind to play the part.

Episodes.Title: Don't try this fake relationship, try a real relationship
Episodes.Description: Ha-ri has a long list of facts about Tae-moo to memorize — as well as someone important to meet. Young-seo declares her independence.

Episodes.Title: It's pretty
Episodes.Description: In and outside of work, Ha-ri scrambles to hide her true identity from Tae-moo and his grandfather. A fake one-year anniversary comes up.

Episodes.Title: I am Shin Ha-ri
Episodes.Description: As payback for being fooled, Tae-moo sets a trap for Ha-ri at a company event. But when she drunkenly apologizes, he has a change of heart.

Episodes.Title: My name is Hari's boyfriend Kang Tae-moo
Episodes.Description: When plans for a confession go awry, Tae-moo takes Ha-ri on a date by the sea disguised as a work trip. Cha Sung-hoon confronts a red-faced Young-seo.

Episodes.Title: I like Shin Ha-ri
Episodes.Description: Tae-moo plays the part of Ha-ri's smitten boyfriend in front of her friends, much to the chagrin of a wary Lee Min-woo and a jealous Go Yoo-ra.

Episodes.Title: I want to think about just the two of us
Episodes.Description: Calling their kiss a mistake, Ha-ri continues to reject Tae-moo's advances. But an unreturned text and word of his blind date stir up her emotions.

Episodes.Title: What are you doing there?
Episodes.Description: Jo Yoo-jung falls for Sung-hoon, landing him in hot water with Young-seo. Tae-moo and Ha-ri try to keep their relationship a secret at work.

Episodes.Title: Thank you for taking me in like this
Episodes.Description: Kang Da-goo's suspicions about his grandson's love life are proven true. On a rainy night after work, Ha-ri takes Tae-moo out on a date.

Episodes.Title: Don't disappear from my sight
Episodes.Description: When Ha-ri's personal life becomes the talk of the town, Tae-moo's grandfather gives her an ultimatum. Young-seo's dad suggests dinner with Sung-hoon.

Episodes.Title: We're getting married
Episodes.Description: Ha-ri tries to win Da-goo over by keeping him company at his hospital bedside. A worried Tae-moo asks Ha-ri to go to the U.S. with him.

Entries.Title: Extraordinary Attorney Woo
Entries.Description: With a genius-level IQ, Woo Young-woo learns to embrace her extraordinary self while forming a tight-knit community of friends and allies.

Episodes.Title: Extraordinary Attorney Woo
Episodes.Description: On her first day at a new job, Woo Young-woo meets an ally, a skeptic and an old acquaintance. She takes on an assault case involving an elderly couple.

Episodes.Title: The Wedding Dress That Slipped Off
Episodes.Description: The father of a bride sues a hotel for a wedding that ended in a humiliating disaster. Lee Jun-ho asks Young-woo to share her whale facts over lunch.

Episodes.Title: This is Pengsoo
Episodes.Description: A tragedy surrounding two brothers forces a family to face a difficult truth. Young-woo attempts to bridge a communication gap with a client.

Episodes.Title: The Strife of the Three Brothers
Episodes.Description: Dong Geu-ra-mi seeks legal advice from Young-woo when her father unknowingly agrees to take on a massive debt. Kwon Min-woo broods in resentment.

Episodes.Title: Wild Card VS Tactician
Episodes.Description: A copyright battle between two ATM companies stokes a rivalry between Young-woo and Min-woo. Geu-ra-mi teaches Young-woo how to spot a liar.

Episodes.Title: If I Were a Whale...
Episodes.Description: Young-woo joins Choi Su-yeon in her mission to reunite a mother with her daughter. They explore every avenue to reduce a four-year sentence.

Episodes.Title: A Tale About Sodeok-dong I
Episodes.Description: Residents of a small town file a class-action lawsuit to stop the construction of a highway. Hanbada Law Firm goes up against their biggest competitor.

Episodes.Title: A Tale About Sodeok-dong II
Episodes.Description: Taesan Law Firm keeps a step ahead of Hanbada Law Firm as conditions lean in their favor. Tae Su-mi makes an offer to Young-woo.

Episodes.Title: The Pied Piper
Episodes.Description: A self-proclaimed leader of the children’s liberation movement gets arrested for kidnapping. Young-woo tries to win Jun-ho’s affection.

Episodes.Title: Holding Hands Can Wait
Episodes.Description: A man faces jail time for taking advantage of a woman with a disability. Jun-ho’s peers frown on his relationship. Min-woo pries into Young-woo's life.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Salt, Ms. Pepper and Attorney Soy Sauce
Episodes.Description: Young-woo lands in a tricky legal position after a married couple seeks counsel to help settle a dispute involving a massive lottery win.

Episodes.Title: Yangtze River Dolphin
Episodes.Description: Young-woo encounters Hanbada’s dark side while working on a wrongful termination lawsuit. Jung Myeong-seok fears he has a target on his back.

Episodes.Title: The Blue Night of Jeju I
Episodes.Description: A temple on Jeju Island goes to court for charging admission to the public, Young-woo meets Jun-ho’s family, and Myeong-seok reflects on his life.

Episodes.Title: The Blue Night of Jeju II
Episodes.Description: The Hanbada lawyers look for the owner of Myeong-seok’s favorite noodle shop. Young-woo faces obstacles at the trial and in her relationship with Jun-ho.

Episodes.Title: Saying and Doing Things Not Asked
Episodes.Description: When Young-woo clashes with her new supervisor during a case for a large online retailer, Myeong-seok advises her to lie low and lean on her peers.

Episodes.Title: Though Unusual and Peculiar
Episodes.Description: Young-woo receives evidence that could make or break her case, while Min-woo changes his plans — and Jun-ho follows his heart.

Entries.Title: Island
Entries.Description: Jeju Island is taken over by evil spirits. An exorcist, priest, and chaebol heiress are fated to fight against evil spirits attempting to end the world. “They are stirring at last.”

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Won Mi-ho is the only heiress to the Daehan Group. She falls for her aunt’s plot and becomes the center of a controversy after beating up a person in the middle of the city. Mi-ho is sent to Jeju Island until things quiet down, but she comes across a lust demon in a wedding dress.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Not only was Mi-ho chased twice by lust demons, but the police are now also treating her like a drug user. She is trying to come up with a plan to escape Jeju Island and go back to Seoul. But before she could get on a plane, she ended up in a life-threatening car chase with a lust demon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Johan moves into Mi-ho’s villa to live with Van and Mi-ho, disguised as Butler Jang’s nephew. Mi-ho is displeased with Van, who doesn’t seem to cooperate and can’t even drive a car. On top of that, Johan starts tagging along to school.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Mi-ho meets the last of Benjulle’s trees after a fierce battle in Benjulle’s forest. Mi-ho returns to her villa after saving Su-ryeon and starts planning on how to punish Gyeong-jun. Meanwhile, Johan provokes Van to find out his identity, summoning the hidden nature of the lust demon. Mi-ho comes to look for Van and Johan and sees Van transforming into a lust demon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Van feels guilty for nearly killing Mi-ho and disappears into the darkness. To find Van, Mi-ho goes through rough mountain tracks to Taejangsa Temple, only to walk away after being hurt by his coldness. Meanwhile, the number of mysterious murder cases where the organs were extracted from the victims is increasing all over Jeju Island. Van is sure that Gungtan has returned after seeing the...

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Johan brings Chan-hee to the villa. They spend time happily together, promising each other that they would not part again. However, Chan-hee has already turned into a lust demon, and he leaves Johan’s room to go after Mi-ho’s life. After finding out about the secret of reincarnation, Mi-ho visits and asks Geum Baek-ju to help her become Wonjeong. Meanwhile, despite exorcising day and night,...

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Long ago, Jeju was thrown into confusion by an outbreak of lust demons. Wonjeong, fated to save the island by establishing the Barrier, secretly visits and forms a friendship with two boys, Van and Gungtan, who were raised solely to kill lust demons. Ten years later, Wonjeong returns to Taejangsa Temple after completing her training to establish the Barrier. However, as soon as she starts...

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Johan overcomes his despair after Chan-hee's death. Mi-ho, who is in pain and blaming herself, vows not to lose anyone else who is precious. From then, she begins receiving intense training from Geum Baek-ju at Granny Haenyeo's Home to regain the power of Wonjeong. Johan and Van follow Mi-ho but observe from a distance so that they don't interrupt her energy. Meanwhile, unfold the stories of...

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Gungtan remembers once again that Wonjeong had sealed him in the past and escapes without being able to harm Mi-ho. Captivated by fear and anger, Gungtan begins to plunge the world into darkness. Mi-ho starts to blame herself, believing that the tragedy will only end when she dies. Meanwhile, illusions of Gusunsae cause Tamra High School students to engage in mass suicide. Despite Johan's...

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Mi-ho finds out about Butler Chang's secret and tries to kill herself as she feels betrayed. The moment Van rushes to Mi-ho and holds her hand, she recovers all the memories from the past. Gungtan rages as he feels dejected after watching Mi-ho fail to regain power even after her memory has returned. Filled with madness, Gungtan prepares for the end by brutally killing the tramps he is...

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Van learns that Mi-ho will vanish if she regains the power, leaving only Wonjeong. After agonizing, Van tries to stop Mi-ho’s training to become Wonjeong. Mi-ho is just frustrated and upset at Van’s sudden behavior. Meanwhile, Gungtan attempts to use Yeom-ji to find out about the location of the remaining Dol Hareubang, and Johan goes to Gungtan’s hideout to fight him to save Geum Baek-ju and...

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: It's finally the day to establish the Barrier. Mi-ho, on her way to the altar, fights a great battle against lust demons alongside Butler Chang, who has returned, and Johan, who woke up from a coma. After defeating countless lust demons, Mi-ho leaves the rest to Van, Johan, and Butler Chang and goes up to the altar. But because of her memories from the past and fear, the Barrier continues to...

Entries.Title: Money Heist: Korea - Joint Economic Area
Entries.Description: Disguised under the shadows of a mask, a crew of desperados band together under the leadership of a criminal mastermind known only as “The Professor” to pull off the biggest heist Korea has ever seen.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Recruited by the Professor for a job of unprecedented proportions, eight thieves storm the Unified Korea Mint. Police pull together a task force.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Seon Woojin waits for a crack in the thieves' operation. An escape plan centered around the retrieval of a hidden smartwatch puts Yun Misun in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: The sound of a gunshot shakes up the Mint. Dissent among the thieves reaches new heights as some believe a line has been crossed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Looking to turn a potential disaster into an opportunity, Woojin presses the Professor to allow medical personnel to enter the Mint.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Cha Moohyuk hurries a plot of his own into action. A key revelation on Woojin's end threatens to unravel the Professor's strategy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: As those outside the Mint panic, Woojin proposes she go inside with a cameraman so the thieves can show the public that the hostages are unharmed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Woojin shifts her tactics after figuring out the real reason for the heist. Kim Sangman appeals to the thieves with a bold promise.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The hostages set their escape plan into motion while Park Chulwoo calls for backup. Cho Youngmin’s attempt to be the first to leave the mint backfires.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: The police interrogate a thief. Sangman steps in to take control of the hostage negotiation. A rescue mission takes place to bring a child to safety.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: The thieves offer the hostages a choice between money and freedom. After finding out about his son's love affair, Moscow reveals his past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: A medical emergency puts the thieves on edge, while the deadline to carry out their plan is cut short. Woojin lures the Professor to a nearby hospital.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: The police close in on the thieves as they prepare to transport the money out of the Mint. Fierce protests force Sangman to put his foot down.

Entries.Title: Squid Game
Entries.Description: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

Episodes.Title: Red Light, Green Light
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win easy money, a broke and desperate Gi-hun agrees to take part in an enigmatic game. Not long into the first round, unforeseen horrors unfold.

Episodes.Title: Hell
Episodes.Description: Split on whether to continue or quit, the group holds a vote. But their realities in the outside world may prove to be just as unforgiving as the game.

Episodes.Title: The Man with the Umbrella
Episodes.Description: A few players enter the next round — which promises equal doses of sweet and deadly — with hidden advantages. Meanwhile, Jun-ho sneaks his way inside.

Episodes.Title: Stick to the Team
Episodes.Description: As alliances form among the players, no one is safe in the dorm after lights-out. The third game challenges Gi-hun's team to think strategically.

Episodes.Title: A Fair World
Episodes.Description: Gi-hun and his team take turns keeping guard through the night. The masked men encounter trouble with their co-conspirators.

Episodes.Title: Gganbu
Episodes.Description: Players pair off for the fourth game. Gi-hun grapples with a moral dilemma, Sang-woo chooses self-preservation and Sae-byeok shares her untold story.

Episodes.Title: VIPS
Episodes.Description: The Masked Leader welcomes VIP guests to the facility for a front-row viewing of the show. In the fifth game, some players crack under pressure.

Episodes.Title: Front Man
Episodes.Description: Ahead of the last round, distrust and disgust run deep among the finalists. Jun-ho makes a getaway, determined to expose the game's dirty secrets.

Episodes.Title: One Lucky Day
Episodes.Description: The final round presents another cruel test — but this time, how it ends depends on just one player. The game's creator steps out of the shadows.

Episodes.Title: Bread and Lottery
Episodes.Description: A vengeful Gi-hun makes a U-turn at the airport. Later, in his hideout, he intensifies his search for the elusive recruiter who is seeking new players.

Episodes.Title: Halloween Party
Episodes.Description: Gi-hun finally gets hold of an invitation, marked for Halloween day. In a tense moment facing Jun-ho, they reveal their truths to each other.
New players gather for a chance to win 45.6 billion won. After an intense first round, the survivors' fates hang in the balance — down to one final vote.

Episodes.Title: Six Legs
Episodes.Description: The players prepare for the next game: a six-legged pentathlon, where each team member must clear a mini-game to survive — or face collective elimination.

Episodes.Title: One More Game
Episodes.Description: Kang No-eul earns enemies for her unruly actions. Nerves fray to the breaking point as the remaining players vote on whether to move to the next round.

Episodes.Title: O ﻿ X
Episodes.Description: Jun-ho and his team prepare to infiltrate a suspicious island. As monetary stakes and tensions rise, players split into two opposing factions.

Episodes.Title: Friend or Foe
Episodes.Description: The remaining players strategize on how to survive the night. Gi-hun proposes a risky plan — but he will need trustworthy allies to carry it out.

Episodes.Title: Keys and Knives
Episodes.Description: No-eul infiltrates a dangerous operation with a risky plan. A new game is announced: hide-and-seek, where one group holds a key and the other a knife.

Episodes.Title: The Starry Night
Episodes.Description: The games resume, and Gi-hun fixates on confronting Kang Dae-ho. Meanwhile, Kim Jun-hee faces a sudden crisis that pushes her willpower to its limits.

Episodes.Title: It's Not Your Fault
Episodes.Description: Jun-ho's team gets close to finding the island. Jang Geum-ja makes a desperate plea to Gi-hun to help Jun-hee. The VIPs discuss a cruel proposal.
Even as Gi-hun supports Jun-hee amid rising tensions, she must make a pivotal decision. Before the final game, the Front Man gives Gi-hun an ultimatum.
No-eul tries to gain the upper hand in negotiations, but her plans backfire. Gi-hun faces a moral crossroads, testing his limits — how far will he go?

Episodes.Title: Humans Are...
Episodes.Description: As Jun-ho races to reach the island, tensions peak in the final round. The last players face an impossible situation in the closing minutes of the game.

Entries.Title: Taxi Driver
Entries.Description: A former special forces soldier delivers revenge for victims of injustice while working for a secret organization that fronts as a taxi company.

Episodes.Title: Do You Want to Take Revenge?
Episodes.Description: Shaken by an abusive experience, a young woman with an intellectual disability takes up the services of Kim Do-gi and his team of revenge seekers.

Episodes.Title: Do-gi Meets Ju-chan
Episodes.Description: With an eye on payback, Do-gi transforms into a deep-pocketed customer to trick Kang Maria's tormentors. Kang Ha-na wonders about a missing criminal.

Episodes.Title: A Victim of a School Violence
Episodes.Description: Do-gi goes undercover as a high school substitute teacher after receiving a call for help from a student who is being severely bullied.

Episodes.Title: Teacher vs Students
Episodes.Description: The three bullies' attempts to mess with Do-gi come to a halt when they realize he possesses video footage that could ruin their lives.

Episodes.Title: The Evil Businessman
Episodes.Description: While Ha-na looks into allegations of employees suffering physical abuse inside a powerful tech company, Do-gi poses as a new recruit there.

Episodes.Title: Into the Strategic Planning Team
Episodes.Description: To gain access to Park Yang-jin's inner circle, Do-gi focuses his efforts on infiltrating a key department within the company.

Episodes.Title: An Untimely Goodbye
Episodes.Description: As the truth behind an exploitative incident involving An Go-eun's sister comes to light, Do-gi sets out for revenge. Ha-na shows up with a warrant.

Episodes.Title: The Vacation Home
Episodes.Description: Do-gi finds himself in danger after Yang-jin gives him a cruel test of loyalty. Go-eun returns to locate and destroy the data servers.

Episodes.Title: The Voice Phishing Scam
Episodes.Description: Ha-na grows suspicious when she finds Do-gi's ID card at the scene of the explosion. Meanwhile, the team takes on a phone scam case.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Wang and Madam Lim
Episodes.Description: Do-gi dons another disguise to lay his charms on the leader of the voice phishing operation. Ha-na keeps a close eye on the team's whereabouts.

Episodes.Title: Tracking Down the Missing Murder Victim
Episodes.Description: Certain that Jang Seong-cheol and his employees are hiding something, Ha-na storms his home. A pastor worries about his missing son.

Episodes.Title: A Colleague's Funeral
Episodes.Description: In mourning, Ha-na goes to Do-gi as a client in search of vengeance. While investigating, the team uncovers a larger scheme at play.

Episodes.Title: A Prisoner Exchange
Episodes.Description: The team is taken by surprise when Baek Yeong-mi empties the secret prison cells. Do-gi plans to use Gu Yeong-tae as a bargaining chip.

Episodes.Title: The Rainbow Transport Team In Danger
Episodes.Description: When Yeong-mi comes after the team, Do-gi throws himself into action to save them from her cruel clutches before it's too late.

Episodes.Title: Rainbow Transport Decide to Disband
Episodes.Description: It's the end of the road for Seong-cheol and the team as they agree to shut down their operation. Do-gi is made to face the demons of his past.

Episodes.Title: One Year Later
Episodes.Description: The team pulls together for one final mission to nail the true culprit behind the death of Do-gi's mother. Ha-na attempts to resign.

Episodes.Title: The Missing Son
Episodes.Description: Despite the disbandment of Rainbow Taxi, Do-ki is still out there going after bad guys. While keeping it from the rest of the members, Do-ki and Sung-cheol secretly help out a father who is searching for his missing son. To confirm his whereabouts, Do-ki sets off abroad to a foreign country to accomplish his first mission.

Episodes.Title: Back In Business
Episodes.Description: Do-ki successfully infiltrates Cheongeum with the help of his old crew. He pretends to be an abducted recruit but secretly searches for Dong-jae. During the search, he runs into Lim Bok-ja. He uses her revengeful anger to make it easier to find the missing boy. Just when he is about to capture the mastermind, a mysterious gun shot interrupts his arrest.

Episodes.Title: The Trot Singer
Episodes.Description: An elderly woman visits Rainbow Transport as a victim. She owes a lot of money because of a young scammer who only rips money off old people. Do-ki and the team get infuriated upon seeing this and set up a plan to prevent this criminal from ever scamming the elderly again.

Episodes.Title: Sang-gi’s Prison
Episodes.Description: Rainbow Transport officially begins its operation to bring punishment to Sang-gi. The plan mainly depends on Sung-cheol being a loaded old man as bait. As soon as Sang-gi sees this and plans to scam him, he does not realize the karma that he is about to face. Meanwhile, the secret organization Do-ki is after is also keeping an eye on Do-ki as well.

Episodes.Title: Feel Consulting
Episodes.Description: Do-ki runs into a stray little girl on the street. Out of concern, he takes her to Rainbow Transport and learns that suspicious people are after her. Do-ki and the team tries to infiltrate Feel Consulting and get some info on Kang Pil-seung to find out why he is in search of this poor little girl.

Episodes.Title: The Evil Uncle
Episodes.Description: Do-ki and Go-eun get busted by Pil-seung for putting up an act. However, Do-ki manages to win back his trust by acting how desperate he is for a house. Now that they are back on track, Do-ki learns how Pil-seung is able to help couples get housing by using children. Disgusted by his ways, the team is determined to bring down Pil-seung at all costs.

Episodes.Title: The SunBaek Cult
Episodes.Description: The next client is a woman named Lee Jin-hee. Her beloved sister Jin-sun is suffering from a terminal disease and is relying on a cult to cure her. To save her from the cult and to take down its leader, Rainbow Transport begins service. However, Do-ki is not the one who will be infiltrating the cult this time.

Episodes.Title: Beating Cult With A Cult
Episodes.Description: The plan to destroy Ok Ju-man is now set. The only thing that remains is for Ju-man to take the bait. Although he does not have faith in any kind of religion, the Rainbow Transport team makes it seem believable. By setting the perfect scam, Ok Ju-man becomes faithful to the fake cult that Do-ki makes.

Episodes.Title: The Surgery Malpractice
Episodes.Description: A smelly drunk man protests alone in front of a big hospital. He claims that his daughter is in a coma due to a surgery malpractice. Although Rainbow Transport took him in as a client, they are not sure whether this is an actual case or just an accident. Before they start anything, Do-ki looks into Ahn Young-sook, the director who performed the surgery.

Episodes.Title: Jeil Chakhan Factory
Episodes.Description: Do-ki becomes a patient himself to infiltrate the operating room. When he is put to sleep, Go-eun finds out that there is a proxy who does the actual surgery while Young-sook goes somewhere else for a drink. Now that the team knows she is a complete fraud, they set up a meticulous plan to bring the witch down.

Episodes.Title: The Late Kim Do-ki
Episodes.Description: Do-ki makes it out alive from the car bomb explosion. He uses his death to track down the person behind the vicious attack. While his funeral progresses, Do-ki and the team monitor any suspicious people coming and going, which leads them to a club for the rich in Gangnam. Do-ki makes his entrance to find out more.

Episodes.Title: The Playground of Evil
Episodes.Description: After Do-ki gets kicked out from Black Sun and gets beaten up, the police arrive. However, the police arrest Do-ki instead. Although Yong-min helps him to bail out, Do-ki now knows that the police are working with Black Sun. Rainbow Transport infiltrates the club to take them down for all the crimes they are committing.

Episodes.Title: Do-ki Crashes The Party
Episodes.Description: An angry VIP client at Black Sun puts the security team on edge. The security team gets a second chance to make another delivery. Only this time, Do-ki joins the team. What he learns is shocking. Meanwhile, Sung-cheol digs into Ha-joon's past.

Episodes.Title: Ha-joon's Defeat
Episodes.Description: While Do-ki wakes up from getting drugged, the bishop comes back to Korea. Now that Do-ki has evidence of how Black Sun is circulating drugs, he sets up a plan. Meanwhile, Ha-joon notices that Rainbow Transport is on Black Sun’s tail. Knowing how skillful Do-ki is, he takes every precaution he can take.

Episodes.Title: Ha-joon Versus Do-ki
Episodes.Description: Rainbow Transport takes in another client. However this time, it is a set-up made by the Bishop and Ha-joon. Not knowing that it is a trap, Do-ki blindly goes into Jangsan Correctional with Kyung-goo and Jin-eon to save a victim. The only thing that is waiting for him is Ha-joon's trap that will break Do-ki into pieces.

Episodes.Title: The Final Client
Episodes.Description: Do-ki goes into Jangsan Correctional as an undercover inmate. He fights all the way through every trap that Ha-joon has prepared for him. Although he barely makes it in one piece, he saves Lee Si-wan. Meanwhile, Ha-joon learns about his true identity and what the Bishop has done to him since his childhood.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Vincenzo
Entries.Description: At the age of eight, Park Joo Hyeong left for Italy after being adopted. Now an adult, he is known as Vincenzo Cassano and employed by a Mafia family as a consigliere. Due to warring Mafia factions, he flies to South Korea where he gets involved with lawyer Hong Cha Young. She is the type of attorney who will do anything to win a case. Now back in his motherland, he gives an unrivalled conglomerate a taste of his own medicine—with a side of his own version of justice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Vincenzo Cassano's homecoming is met by distrusting tenants and eager fraudsters. Hong Yu-chan relinquishes his parental rights to Hong Cha-young.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Warned about a scheduled demolition of Geumga Plaza, Vincenzo contrives to thwart the attack. Yu-chan receives a call from a whistleblower.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Vincenzo warns an impassioned Yu-chan about the dangers of a new drug and its even more harmful pharmaceutical company. Choi Myung-hee shows her claws.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Fighting fire with fire, Yu-chan's supporters unite their efforts to carry out his vision of justice. Vincenzo employs Myung-hee's tactics against her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Jang Joon-woo reminds Jang Han-seo who's the boss. The tenants rally around Vincenzo and Cha-young, who team up to take down Babel Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Both sides use every trick in the book to cause disturbances in and out of the courtroom. Han Seung-hyuk and Myung-hee are introduced to Babel's CEO.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Stumped by surprise witnesses, Joon-woo and Myung-hee direct their rage toward Cha-young. The tenants gain new appreciation for their building.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Angered by another conglomerate and its generations of unpunished crimes, Vincenzo tries to charm a young bank president out of investing in Babel.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Joon-woo wields his power to force loyalty from his partners. Cha-young finds refuge in Vincenzo's apartment following a break-in.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Seeking revenge instead of liability for the loss of more innocent victims, Vincenzo puts his life on the line to lure Babel's CEO out of hiding.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: The search for Jang Han-seok begins with torturing his lackeys for information. An Gi-seok flashes his work badge to free Vincenzo from prosecution.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Han-seo faces unintended consequences when he takes a shot at Babel's throne. Vincenzo and Cho Ju-yeong finally get Geumga Plaza to themselves.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Ju-yeong reveals his true motive. As incoming CEO, Han-seok is met with admiration, applause and a mafia-styled surprise from Vincenzo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: To expose Han-seok’s paper company, Vincenzo and Cha-young go undercover as an enamored couple. Seo Mi-ri reveals her high-tech tricks.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: With ample evidence to lock up Han-seok, Jung In-kuk holds a press conference. Vincenzo channels spirits to turn an ill-famed newspaper against Babel.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Maddened by Vincenzo's ability to slip out of another one of his bloody traps, Han-seok goes after what Vincenzo cherishes the most.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: A grieving Vincenzo crashes a party to bleed Babel Group dry of its powerful allies. Seung-hyuk reaches out to a high-level commander for help.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Fearing for his life, Han-seok goes to jail to bide some time. A visitor from Italy tells Vincenzo his help is urgently needed back home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Vincenzo and Cha-young present damning evidence against Babel Tower and its influential cronies. Myung-hee proves her loyalty toward Han-seok.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Han-seok lets nothing stand in his way of revenge. Seeking justice the mafia way, Vincenzo gives his enemies a slow and painful death.

Entries.Title: The King's Affection
Entries.Description: When the crown prince is killed, his twin sister assumes the throne while trying to keep her identity and affection for her first love a royal secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Years after the crown princess delivers forbidden twins, Yi Hwi meets a court maid who looks exactly like him, to his amazement and his mother’s horror.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Dam-i tearfully bears the weight of the crown in guise of her brother. Jung Ji-un races against time to find a herbal remedy for a peeved patient.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Hwi spares Ji-un his life thinking they won't ever cross paths again. Later, she's startled to see him lurking inside the palace walls.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ji-un proves to be a formidable opponent for Hwi, who's determined to make her newest royal tutor resign. Yi Hyun takes Hwi out on the town.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ji-un's good-hearted attempt to make his pupil warm up to people in the palace goes awry. Prince Changun tests Hwi with an intoxicating surprise.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: A familiar book on the crown prince's desk baffles Ji-un. Running out of time and the means to save his friends, he asks Hwi for help.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Hwi earns a chance to gain the king's trust during the Ming envoys' visit, but an ill-tempered guest tests the limits of her patience.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ji-un comforts a tearful Hwi in his arms. Hyun and Ji-un team up to figure out the envoy's secret after a suspicious man visits his quarters.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: The queen dowager tells the crown prince to wed. As Ji-un recalls previous night's events, he realizes the reason behind his rollercoaster of emotions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: After a joyous day together, Hwi gives Ji-un her answer. Shin So-eun and No Ha-gyeong visit the palace as candidates to become the next crown princess.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Hyun visits Ji-un at his new clinic. A furious Hwi holds Prince Changun accountable for his wrongdoing, and faces staggering backlash as a result.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: The king is asked to answer to overwhelming appeals for the crown prince's removal. Reentering the palace, Ji-un promises to protect Hwi no matter what.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Hwi carefully reveals her secret to Ji-un. Lord Sangheon unleashes his royal ambitions and makes way for the future king.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Hwi and Ha-gyeong spend their first night together. Reinstated into a palace operating around Lord Sangheon, Ji-un lies low to serve the wounded king.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Moving in silence, Hwi strategizes retaliation against her grandfather. Kim Ga-on reappears in front of the king with a startling confession.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Yoon Hyeong-seol sets out to find the damning ledger and keep his promise to the king. Prince Wonsan puts two and two together about Hwi's identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Rumors about Hwi and Ji-un's close relationship circulate amongst the palace staff. To protect his son, Jung Seok-jo takes matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Hyun and Lord Sangheon learn of Prince Wonsan's secret ploy to dethrone the king. Hwi prepares to take down her grandfather — alone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Prince Wonsan ruthlessly proves his ambitions — and worthiness — for kingship to Lord Sangheon. Hwi prepares to abdicate the throne.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Returning to the palace with a vengeance and an army, Lord Sangheon and Prince Wonsan spare no one in their bloody path to the crown.

Entries.Title: Hometown Cha-Cha-Cha
Entries.Description: A big-city dentist opens up a practice in a close-knit seaside village, home to a charming jack-of-all-trades who is her polar opposite in every way.

Episodes.Title: The moment I met you everywhere
Episodes.Description: Things look bleak for Yoon Hye-jin after she quits her job. On a trip to Gongjin, she runs into a series of unfortunate events — and one unusual local.

Episodes.Title: The moment your sincerity took a step forward
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin gets ready to welcome patients. But when a mishap at a party lands her in the town's bad graces, she needs guidance from Hong Du-sik.

Episodes.Title: The moment your heart smiled at me
Episodes.Description: A long drive to Seoul with Du-sik and other uninvited passengers tests Hye-jin's patience. Despite pain in her teeth, Kim Gam-ri refuses treatment.

Episodes.Title: The moment your temperature melted my heart
Episodes.Description: When a patient causes a disturbance at the office, Du-sik comes to the rescue. Elsewhere, Chang Yeong-guk learns that his first love is back in town.

Episodes.Title: The moment your feelings floated on the waves
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin is seen leaving Du-sik's home one morning. While she tries to recall what happened the night before, the town's gossip mill goes into overdrive.

Episodes.Title: The moment your gaze goes beyond friendship
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin resolves to stop getting involved with Du-sik. Oh Ju-ri enters a singing competition in an attempt to win money to fix her snaggletooth.

Episodes.Title: The moment your loneliness leaned on me
Episodes.Description: Preparing to film his TV show in Gongjin, Ji Seong-hyeon has the perfect guide and house in mind — but getting them takes extra convincing.

Episodes.Title: The moment your existence erases the darkness
Episodes.Description: Du-sik catches a nasty cold. Hye-jin notices a troubling trend among her patients. A kidnapper on the loose puts the town on high alert.

Episodes.Title: Your seat, the moment you draw your daily life
Episodes.Description: Du-sik puts on a show pretending to be Hye-jin's boyfriend in front of her visiting parents. Seong-hyeon makes a good impression on her father.

Episodes.Title: The moment your love reaches 'us'
Episodes.Description: Following an intruder attack in her home, a shaken Hye-jin leans on Du-sik. She's left more conflicted than ever after Seong-hyeon asks to talk.

Episodes.Title: The moment when your excitement becomes my happiness
Episodes.Description: Before Hye-jin makes things official with Du-sik, there's something she needs to do first. Attempts to keep their relationship a secret backfire on them.

Episodes.Title: The moment your wish dreams of ‘together’
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin compiles a long bucket list of activities she wants to experience with Du-sik. Pyo Mi-seon and Choi Eun-cheol finally arrive on the same page.

Episodes.Title: Your Today is the Moment You Wish for Tomorrow
Episodes.Description: As Du-sik continues to keep his past shrouded in mystery, Hye-jin grows frustrated. Ham Yun-gyeong is struck by an emergency during a typhoon.

Episodes.Title: The moment your promise bring up courage
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin and Du-sik take some time apart. Yu Cho-hui urges Yeong-guk to have courage about his feelings. Seong-hyeon and his team wrap up filming.

Episodes.Title: The moment your sadness greets spring
Episodes.Description: With his secrets out in the open, Du-sik must find a way to move on from the tragedies of his past. Hye-jin considers an enticing job offer.

Episodes.Title: The moment our lives dance with everyone
Episodes.Description: The town gathers to bid goodbye to a loved one. Hye-jin plans an unforgettable event for Du-sik, but it turns out he had the same idea.

Entries.Title: The Devil Judge
Entries.Description: The court system is corrupted and old-fashioned. People desire a new system that can satisfy the crowds. However, are the crowds always correct? The drama shows how judges discover the truth about people in court. It centers around a chief judge who doesn’t believe in justice, but only makes judgements that the crowds will be satisfied with. An assistant judge starts to question his motives and tries to find the truth.

Episodes.Title: A Monster Emerges in Turbulent Times
Episodes.Description: After two years of turmoil brought on by an unidentifiable disease that dramatically comes to an end, the government plans to hold an experimental trial where the people are the judges. Kang Yo Han, the presiding judge of the experiment, is known for his unforgiving ways of justice. However, is justice what he genuinely intends? The newly appointed presiding judge, Associate Judge Kim Ga On, starts to suspect Judge Kang, whom he admires.

Episodes.Title: The Yellow Porsche
Episodes.Description: Judge Kang Yo Han yawns as a victim weeps in front of him. As everyone applauds him for his sentence, Judge Kim Ga On's distrust in him deepens. Although Judge Kang senses Ga On's skepticism, he still invites him into his dazzling world. A tug of war between the enigmatic Kang Yo Han and the mystified Kim Ga On begins.

Episodes.Title: The Quiet Mansion
Episodes.Description: An explosion in a judge's office shocks the entire nation. Was this an act of terror, or was it someone's warning message to Yo Han? However, Yo Han continues to race towards justice. What is the next trial he has prepared? Meanwhile, Ga On, who had lost consciousness while saving Yo Han, wakes up in a quiet mansion.

Episodes.Title: Yo Han's Older Brother
Episodes.Description: With new information, Ga On falls deeper into confusion. He and Soo Hyun investigate Yo Han's past, and Lee Young Min fails to stop the indictment against him. Meanwhile, Cha Kyung Hee gets engulfed with anger against Yo Han and tries to figure out how to save her son.

Episodes.Title: Ga On's Comeback
Episodes.Description: Ga On returns and starts working with Yo Han and Jin Joo again. His fans and the public welcome his comeback. Kyung Hee secretly visits his son in prison and watches him in grave pain. Then, Sun Ah comes up with a new strategy for Kyung Hee to tackle the situation. Meanwhile, a famous actor who has a young daughter is accused of committing sexual violence against his female colleagues, and the live trial starts.

Episodes.Title: Suspicion Against Yo Han
Episodes.Description: Ga On introduces Elijah to Soo Hyun, but this makes Yo Han furious. Yo Han strongly warns Ga On not to do anything to Elijah. Kyung Hee holds a press conference and claims that Yo Han bribed a witness who made a testimony on his first live court show. The public gets deeply disappointed by Yo Han. Meanwhile, Soo Hyun gets attacked while following a witness of the Joo Il Do case.

Episodes.Title: A Declaration of War
Episodes.Description: Yo Han declares war against the state as he admits to his crimes in front of the people. The people of power at the foundation are outraged at Yo Han's surprise attack. But strangely, Sun Ah remains calm as if she had anticipated it. What does Sun Ah have up her sleeve? Meanwhile, Ga On reminds Yo Han, who has lost all faith in the world, of the importance of justice, as Yo Han takes him somewhere.

Episodes.Title: Ga On Chooses a Side
Episodes.Description: Ga On gets shocked after realizing the prisoner isn't the man he remembers. And for the first time, Yo Han candidly reveals the hardships of his life to Ga On. All the beliefs and morals Ga On has lived by crash down on him as he experiences firsthand the corruption of those in power. Now, he slowly recognizes his developing sympathy toward Yo Han. Will Ga On take Yo Han's hand against the recklessness of those in power and stop them?

Episodes.Title: Ga On’s Revenge
Episodes.Description: Yo Han is like a hyena playing with its prey while Sun Ah hovers around the live court show. Sun Ah's presence disturbs him. But for some strange reason, he notices the loneliness hidden in the smiling face she shows him. What is the definition of the relationship between them? Meanwhile, Ga On determines to stand by Yo Han, who he thought was evil, and together, they go after the people of power, the truly evil ones.

Episodes.Title: The Revolutionist
Episodes.Description: An immense figure stands hidden behind Juk Chang, the YouTube star who was only considered to be attention-grabbing. Shocked by this new information, Yo Han and Ga On decided to put Juk Chang on trial in the live court. However, it's not an easy task with the police protecting Juk Chang. With the help of Soo Hyun, they start their hunt for Juk Chang.

Episodes.Title: Failed Ambition
Episodes.Description: Sun Ah realizes that her secret has been exposed to Cha Kyung Hee, and the sense of betrayal toward Yo Han deepens. Meanwhile, Kyung Hee makes an irrefutable offer to Sun Ah, and she has to make an extreme choice. Now that she is in a tight spot, Sun Ah looks for Yo Han, but as if he was expecting her to come, Yo Han makes an offer of his own. Two offers stand, and one of them will eventually result in a tragic ending.

Episodes.Title: Stay Away from Me
Episodes.Description: After Kyung Hee committed suicide, Ga On and Yo Han run into Soo Hyun in Kyung Hee’s office. Feeling betrayed and disappointed by Ga On, Soo Hyun warns him to stay away from her. Meanwhile, now that Kyung Hee has been eliminated, Sun Ah starts to believe that Yo Han is on her side. She suggests to Joong Se that Yo Han should be the next president.

Episodes.Title: To Kill or To Be Killed
Episodes.Description: Yo Han gets injured, and at the same time, Ga On finds himself in a tight spot while trying to help the residents in Hyungsan-dong. Neither of them can rely on the other for help, but they must somehow escape the life-endangering situation. On top of that, the nation is faced with the nationwide epidemic due to the so-called virus, possibly led by Sun Ah and the foundation.

Episodes.Title: A Life for a Life
Episodes.Description: Ga On loses Soo Hyun, and his reason to live dies with her. As Yo Han empathizes with what Ga On is going through, he helps Ga On find another reason to live. Together they prepare a trial to punish Juk Chang. However, it feels as if they are thinking different things. Will Yo Han and Ga On get through the live court show without any issues?

Episodes.Title: A Stay of Execution
Episodes.Description: Due to Ga On's shocking announcement of the live court's manipulation in cases, Juk Chang's trial comes to an abrupt stop. Although he thinks he made the righteous move, something troubles his heart. For Yo Han, being betrayed by someone he trusted changes him to someone unlike himself. Meanwhile, the foundation directors move on to their next target and plot to take down Sun Ah. Will Sun Ah win the battle against the directors?

Episodes.Title: To Save Yo Han
Episodes.Description: After Yo Han is put in prison, Ga On blames himself, thinking that his distrust of Yo Han caused all this chaos. He decides to fix everything even if that means he should risk his life. Soon, he hears the news that Yo Han was killed in prison. Joong Se and the members of the foundation feel happy with the news of Yo Han’s death, and at the same time, they plot against Sun Ah.

Entries.Title: D.P.
Entries.Description: A young private's assignment to capture army deserters reveals the painful reality endured by each enlistee during his compulsory call of duty.

Episodes.Title: A Man Holding Flowers
Episodes.Description: An Jun-ho's keen eye earns him a position in the Deserter Pursuit unit. On his first mission with Park Sung-woo, things don't go quite as planned.

Episodes.Title: Daydream
Episodes.Description: Discharged from the hospital, Han Ho-yeol returns to the base and partners up with Jun-ho to search for a soldier last spotted at a subway station.

Episodes.Title: That Woman
Episodes.Description: Jun-ho and Ho-yeol assist with a mission while on break. In an attempt to gain intel, the two go undercover to befriend a deserter's girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: The Monty Hall Problem
Episodes.Description: Relentless hazing shifts Cho Suk-bong's once-warm personality. Riddled with responsibilities, an enlistee jumps the fence at the dead of night.

Episodes.Title: Military Dog
Episodes.Description: Suk-bong is pushed over the edge. During their investigation, the D.P. duo learns of events that unfolded at Hwang Jang-soo's discharge.

Episodes.Title: Onlookers
Episodes.Description: When a chase after a deserter turns into a manhunt for a criminal at large, Jun-ho and Ho-yeol rush to find him before armed men bring him down.

Episodes.Title: The Rains
Episodes.Description: Jun-ho navigates his life post-tragedy. Park Beom-gu feels pressure to cover up recent events. A sudden attack shocks the military.

Episodes.Title: Dirty Play
Episodes.Description: While Kim Ru-ri goes public with his motive, Seo Eun sets up a lure to catch him. Jun-ho and Ho-yeol attempt to stop the growing escalation.

Episodes.Title: Curtain Call
Episodes.Description: Jun-ho and Ho-yeol receive unexpected praise from the military. They later set off to catch a deserter who was bullied relentlessly for being different.

Episodes.Title: The Charred Remains
Episodes.Description: Lim Ji-seop and Beom-gu realize that an investigation into a military death isn't as it seems. The government faces a damning accusation.

Episodes.Title: An Jun-ho
Episodes.Description: Jun-ho discovers the extent of the military's secrets — making a critical decision. Oh Min-u pursues crucial evidence to stop it from being released.

Episodes.Title: The Day
Episodes.Description: Ho-yeol makes a deal to help Jun-ho, who faces harsh consequences. In a fight for justice, the trial against the government takes a surprising turn.

Entries.Title: My Name
Entries.Description: Following her father's murder, a revenge-driven woman puts her trust in a powerful crime boss — and enters the police force under his direction.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: On her birthday, Yoon Ji-woo witnesses the horrific death of her father. Hell-bent on taking revenge at any cost, she sets out to find his killer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Choi Mu-jin imposes punishment on Do Gang-jae. Instructed to join the police force undercover, Ji-woo takes on a brand-new identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: When her team goes after an unforeseen target in a sudden raid, Ji-woo must act fast. A new drug ring and its malevolent leader threaten Mu-jin's empire.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Cha Gi-ho sees Gang-jae's declaration of war on Mu-jin as an opportunity. Suspecting Ji-woo is up to something, Jeon Pil-do tails her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ji-woo and Pil-do's narrow escape from peril shifts the police's focus onto Gang-jae. A run-in with a familiar face at the precinct places Ji-woo on edge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: A photo in the mail revealing obscured truths casts everything Ji-woo thought she believed into doubt. Mu-jin moves to protect his interests.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Ji-woo fights off an ambush. Mu-jin submits himself to a police interrogation. Pil-do gets his hands on incriminating phone call records.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Intent on changing Ji-woo's mind about carrying out her vengeance, Pil-do handcuffs himself to her. Mu-jin reacts to another act of betrayal.

Entries.Title: Bad and Crazy
Entries.Description: A superhero drama about Soo-yeol who has lived his whole life as a materialistic police detective, but changes into a champion for justice and fights against police corruption when a hidden persona called "K" awakens inside him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After getting an officer suspended from service, Ryu Su-yeol gets a step closer to a promotion. Oh Gyeong-tae looks for a young girl's missing mom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Su-yeol retraces Gyeong-tae's steps while tracking down the man in the helmet. Lee Hui-gyeom goes after a necklace that may hold crucial evidence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Su-yeol falls from Do Yu-gon's good graces. While searching for the necklace at home, Su-yeol finds a collection of objects that are not his.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After ensuring Gyeong-tae's safety, Su-yeol pulls a dirty move. With Kim Gye-sik back on the force, the narcotics unit tracks down a street drug.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Su-yeol searches high and low to prove Hui-gyeom's innocence. But the deeper he dives into the case, the closer he comes to falling into a trap.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Su-yeol reopens a closed case. He teams up with K to investigate quietly and uncovers the opponent's weakness. Meanwhile, the body count grows.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Su-yeol and Hui-gyeom shift focus to the head of the drug cartel. Ms. Yong threatens the police to get the seized assets back in her hands.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Su-yeol learns that K is closely linked to his childhood trauma. A girl shows up at the police station, delirious and covered in someone else's blood.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: When bits of his memory return, Su-yeol reexamines the murder of his father. Finding similar cases, he learns one person was involved in all of them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: As the identity of X comes to light, his deranged schemes pick up pace. He comes between Su-yeol and K by revealing K's murderous instincts.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Su-yeol visits Shin Ju-hyeok to seek treatment, but unleashes a very angry K instead. A victim opens up after an attempted suicide.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Su-yeol's hunt for the truth endangers those around him. He has a final face-off with the crazed killer at the place where it all began.

Entries.Title: Hellbound
Entries.Description: Unearthly beings deliver bloody condemnations, sending individuals to hell and giving rise to a religious group founded on the idea of divine justice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Horrified bystanders watch as otherworldly beasts chase down and kill a man in broad daylight. Jung Jinsu declares that only sinners are sent to hell.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The New Truth offers a sizable payment to Park Jungja, a condemned woman, in exchange for the right to live-broadcast the moment her fate is decided.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Addressing a stunned world, Jinsu preaches righteousness. Detective Jin Kyunghun searches for his missing daughter. The Arrowhead targets Min Hyejin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Bae Youngjae follows his co-worker to a fishing dock, where he witnesses a terrifying sight. The Prophet Angel appears in an unthinkable place.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: A despairing Youngjae tracks down a man who he thinks might have answers. The New Truth catches wind of a mysterious organization with its own agenda.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: With detrimental information hanging over its head, The New Truth scrambles to protect its power by preventing the public from learning the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After a series of visions, Jinsu finds himself mysteriously resurrected. Realizing he's losing power, Kim Jeongchil agrees to work with the government.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: While in hiding, Kyunghun and his daughter suddenly come under attack. Meanwhile, the New Truth accelerates their announcement plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Jeongchil manipulates Jungja to carry out the New Will. As Jinsu learns more about Cheon Sehyeong, he begins to form his escape plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Jinsu puts forward his plot to come face to face with Jungja. However, Hyejin decides to carry out her own rescue plan to retrieve Jungja for Sodo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: As Hyejin, Jinsu and Jeongchil all try to grab ahold of Jungja, Senior Secretary Lee plays her own game on the sidelines — but chaos arises everywhere.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Jinsu confronts Jungja, desperately searching for answers. But as disorder unfolds, will Hyejin be able to get Jungja to safety before it's too late?

Entries.Title: Doom at Your Service
Entries.Description: A woman with only a short time to live and a man with the supernatural power to bring the world to an end discover the true meaning of life and love.

Episodes.Title: I'm Really Dying
Episodes.Description: After having the worst day of her life, Tak Dong-gyeong wishes for the world to end. A stranger shows up at her door to make that desire a reality.

Episodes.Title: Hold My Hand
Episodes.Description: Dong-gyeong realizes that the hundred-day pact with Myeol-mang comes with heavy consequences if she refuses to fulfill her end of the bargain.

Episodes.Title: Living Together with Myeol-mang
Episodes.Description: As Dong-gyeong deals with a demanding new roommate, she looks for a loophole in her agreement with Myeol-mang to save her loved ones from doom.

Episodes.Title: How to Love Myeol-mang
Episodes.Description: In a desperate attempt to destroy Myeol-mang by winning him over, Dong-gyeong seeks the help of a romance expert.

Episodes.Title: Why Would She Do That?
Episodes.Description: Puzzled by Dong-gyeong's act of self-sacrifice, Myeol-mang decides to keep close tabs on her to figure out her true intentions.

Episodes.Title: Now What?
Episodes.Description: Dong-gyeong looks for another subject to fall in love with. Na Ji-na attends a high school reunion hoping to see an old flame.

Episodes.Title: And Then He Was Gone
Episodes.Description: Myeol-mang comes to a difficult decision after being reminded of the part he played in bringing grief and sadness into Dong-gyeong's life.

Episodes.Title: I Knew You Would Come
Episodes.Description: After a short-lived reunion, Dong-gyeong has her love and trust in Myeol-mang tested while he navigates a world where she never existed.

Episodes.Title: Soo-ja Finds Out
Episodes.Description: Lee Hyeon-gyu shows up at Ji-na’s door to get something off his chest. Dong-gyeong goes on a shopping spree to prepare for a final goodbye.

Episodes.Title: An Unexpected Answer
Episodes.Description: Myeol-mang makes a heartfelt confession. A writer accuses Ji-na of plagiarism. Dong-gyeong makes a painful choice to save her loved ones.

Episodes.Title: A Date with Myeol-mang
Episodes.Description: After spending time with good company, Dong-gyeong returns to her old life while Myeol-mang finds himself transformed. Ji-na works on a new series.

Episodes.Title: The Forgotten Ones
Episodes.Description: Myeol-mang punishes criminals who run free. Dong-gyeong meets a ghost at the hospital. Ji-na and Hyeon-gyu feel a growing distance between them.

Episodes.Title: Who Are You?
Episodes.Description: Myeol-mang keeps an eye on Dong-gyeong hoping to figure out who she is. Ji-na clears the air with Hyeon-gyu but makes up her mind to move on.

Episodes.Title: Cold Heartless Fate
Episodes.Description: After promising a life together, Myeol-mang and Dong-gyeong make the most of the time they have left.

Episodes.Title: A Butterfly for a Flower
Episodes.Description: Upon receiving a second chance, Dong-gyeong moves forward with her life, while holding on tightly to the memories of her past.

Episodes.Title: I No Longer Bring Doom
Episodes.Description: Having found the person to spend the rest of her life with, Dong-gyeong finds hope and meaning for the future.

Entries.Title: The Uncanny Counter
Entries.Description: A group of supernatural demon hunters known as "Counters," each with unique abilities, disguise themselves as employees of a noodle restaurant, while tracking down evil spirits that terrorize the mortal world.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: On his birthday, So Mun's struck by a strange burst of light that leaves puzzling changes to his body. He finds answers inside the local noodle shop.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The Counters give Mun an extraordinary surprise. While contemplating whether he wants to join them, he's given a taste of the action.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Lim Ju-yeon and Kim Ung-min notice something is different about Mun. Ga Mo-tak heads to the police station for answers about his forgotten past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: In a confrontation with violent bullies, Mun loses control over his rage — and must face the consequences. Mo-tak is reunited with his old cellphone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Do Ha-na saves Mun from the attacks of a powerful demon with a malicious tongue. Kim Jeong-yeong helps Mo-tak look into his last detective case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: While the Counters attempt to keep the truth behind his painful past from Mun, he discovers a mysterious memory card among his parents' belongings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: During a trip into his most traumatic memory, Mun has his first encounter with Ji Cheong-sin. Later, he leads the Counters to a car junkyard.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Things get personal for Ha-na as she takes down a familiar demon. The team tries to locate a reservoir tied to a case Mun's father had worked.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Cheong-sin leaves Mun in a bad state, but Chu Mae-ok is determined to save his life. The Counters set out to make the mayor's corruption public.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Wi-gen calls for an action that could take everything away from Mun. When stunning news about Cheong-sin is reported, the Counters can't believe it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: The Counters struggle in a mismatched fight against an increasingly dangerous Cheong-sin and the other demons. Mo-tak's memories resurface.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: A heartbroken Mo-tak and the team plot revenge against Shin Myeong-hwi and his collaborators. While carrying out their scheme, a human corpse turns up.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: As Cheong-sin becomes nearly unstoppable, the Counters learn there may be a way to defeat him for good. Mo-tak gets justice for Jeong-yeong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Myeong-hwi's son notices something about his father isn't quite right. When Baek Hyang-hui kidnaps a young girl, the Counters rush after her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: The team welcomes back a Counter who's been overseas. After confirming his suspicions about his father, Shin Hyeok-u goes to Mun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: The final face-off against Myeong-hwi tests Mun and the other Counters' limits. In Yung, long-awaited reunions take place.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: It's business as usual for the Counters as they work together to defeat malicious demons. Meanwhile, trouble starts brewing in a remote mansion in China.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Ga Mo-tak discovers the perfect recruit when he witnesses a car accident. Hwang Pil-gwang, Gelly, and Wong arrive in Korea and begin wreaking havoc.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: The Counters are confronted with an unwelcome visitor at the noodle shop. Amidst a training session with his new protégé, Mo-tak hears alarming news.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: So Mun goes head to head with Pil-gwang, while his teammates battle the demon's cronies. Meanwhile, Ma Ju-seok experiences a terrifying nightmare.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ju-seok's impassioned statement shocks the Counters — but the demons watch on with glee. Do Ha-na reunites with an important figure from her past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The Counters face a new, formidable demon and gather to devise a plan of action. Pil-gwang and Gelly head to the hospital with a sinister motive.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: So Mun experiences a moment of weakness during a crucial battle. Gelly faces a betrayal. The Counters later attempt to put a stop to a fraud scheme.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ha-na decides to follow through with a devastating decision. Meanwhile, Chu Mae-ok lends a helping hand to a troublemaking young man.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: The Counters go neck to neck with Pil-gwang's gang. So Mun is trapped in a life-threatening predicament, and his teammates struggle to find a solution.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Ju-seok and Pil-gwang face a change in their relationship. The Counters celebrate some good news.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Pil-gwang grows more powerful by the day. Although hesitant at first, Ha-na assists So Mun in a dangerous endeavor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: The Counters give it their all to fight the mighty Pil-gwang. Will Ju-seok be able to overcome his demons and put an end to this life-or-death battle?

Entries.Title: Mr. Queen
Entries.Description: A modern chef suddenly becomes trapped inside the body of a queen from the Joseon era, which causes chaos for everyone involved.

Episodes.Title: Jang Bong Hwan in Wonderland
Episodes.Description: Bong Hwan is a successful young chef, but he finds himself in trouble. After accidentally falling into a swimming pool while being chased by the police, he wakes up in the Joseon dynasty in a woman’s body. And the body he is trapped in belongs to the future queen of all people. Bong Hwan must find a way to go back.

Episodes.Title: Nobody Knows
Episodes.Description: Bong Hwan’s life as So Yong, the queen, begins in earnest. The rigidity of the palace wears Bong Hwan out, but he runs into the woman of his dreams. The problem is that she is Jo Hwa Jin, the woman King Cheoljong is in love with. Meanwhile, the Grand Queen Dowager and Kim Jwa Geun sense that something is off with So Yong.

Episodes.Title: Sleeping With The Enemy
Episodes.Description: So Yong escapes from danger with the help of her cousin, Byeong In. Cheoljong becomes aware of the Kim clan’s movements to protect So Yong and grows suspicious of her. Meanwhile, So Yong misses modern food and decides to make it herself in the royal kitchen. She decides that she must win over the Grand Queen Dowager’s heart with food.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Knows Too Much
Episodes.Description: So Yong gets furious as she realizes it is Cheoljong who is trying to kill her. Cheoljong also assumes So Yong is planning revenge over him as O Wol, the court maid of Hwa Jin, goes missing after that.

Episodes.Title: Susceptible Heels
Episodes.Description: To save Hwa Jin, So Yong reveals the truth about the lake incident in front of everyone. Grand Queen Dowager gets angry at So Yong for ruining her plan in bringing down the Jo clan. Meanwhile, Cheoljong feels bad for So Yong as he realizes that she jumped into the lake by herself.

Episodes.Title: Between Understanding and Misunderstanding
Episodes.Description: Cheoljong saves So Yong when she jumps into the water to go back to the present day. Cheoljong starts to see So Yong differently and tries to start fresh with her. Meanwhile, So Yong is hopeless as she fails to go back even when she drowns herself in the lake. She attempts every method to get in touch with the spirit that is in Bong Hwan’s body.

Episodes.Title: Mask
Episodes.Description: After inventing delivery system in Joseon dynasty, So Yong gains motivation in her new life. However, she suddenly travels back into the body of Bong Hwan in the present day and realizes that he is in a vegetative state. Meanwhile, as the spirit of Bong Hwan left the body of So Yong, she collapses and that leaves the Palace in an uproar.

Episodes.Title: A Dangerous Relationship
Episodes.Description: When Bong Hwan wakes up in So Yong’s body again, he regains more memories of actual So Yong. He gets upset as he loses his true identity from the present day. Meanwhile, Hwa Jin feels insecure as Cheoljong visits So Yong in her family house. Hwa Jin quickly follows after him to stop Cheoljong from seeing So Yong.

Episodes.Title: Light and Darkness
Episodes.Description: So Yong wants to go back to the Palace, but Cheoljong suggests staying one more day as he is still looking for the secret ledger. Cheoljong goes out to the street in disguise, and So Yong accompanies him. Meanwhile, Queen Dowager braces herself to fight Grand Queen Dowager back after she gets insulted.

Episodes.Title: Living a Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Cheoljong returns to the Palace without finding the ledger. He wonders who took it away before he did. Meanwhile, So Yong tries to become a perfect queen to satisfy the Grand Queen Dowager when she returns to the Palace. Also, she starts the investiture of the Royal Concubine to hunt down the Han family.

Episodes.Title: The Unforgiven
Episodes.Description: Cheoljong appears in So Yong’s dream and So Yong is confused about her feelings. She assumes it is a side effect from travelling back and forth in time. She decides to focus on the investiture of the Royal Concubine to retrieve her true identity. Meanwhile, Cheoljong prepares for the royal banquet, but someone tries to ruin it behind his back.

Episodes.Title: Dancing on The Swor
Episodes.Description: So Yong tracks down the man who looks exactly like Secretary Han and notices his shady move in the Royal Kitchen. As she knows how much effort Cheoljong has put into the banquet, she helps him by doing what she does best. Meanwhile, Kim Jwa Geun suddenly delivers a piece of news in front of everyone to threaten Cheoljong.

Episodes.Title: There is No Tomorrow
Episodes.Description: Cheoljong gets seriously injured from the explosion and become unconscious. Kim Jwa Geun threatens So Yong again to accept his suggestion, and So Yong jumps into the lake to regain more memories. Meanwhile, Kim Jwa Geun believes that So Yong is no longer on his side as he finds out that So Yong helped Cheoljong to save the banquet.

Episodes.Title: A Woman Who Must Die To Live
Episodes.Description: So Yong gets drunk and mistaken Cheoljong for Hong Yeon. So Yong starts avoiding Cheoljong when she finds out that they spent the night together. Cheoljong gets upset because So Yong treats him harshly. Meanwhile, someone comes to see Cheoljong and tells him that So Yong is in danger.

Episodes.Title: The Crazy X In This Palace
Episodes.Description: Everyone who lives in a palace has secrets. Bong Hwan is a chef working at the Blue House in the present day. He is so talented that he can figure out one’s health conditions and even get into their mind by just observing what they pick for their side dishes. He somehow gets trapped in the body of Kim So Yong, a queen in the Joseon dynasty, and meets King Cheoljong, the two-faced king full of secrets.

Episodes.Title: All In
Episodes.Description: After Cheoljong shares about the future of Joseon he dreams of with So Yong, she decides to help Cheoljong to fulfill his dream by applying knowledge from the present day. Byeong In feels jealous as Cheoljong and So Yong become closer every day. Meanwhile, Hwa Jin decides to tell Cheoljong the truth about the well incident.

Episodes.Title: Pregnancy Is Beautiful
Episodes.Description: Everyone including Cheoljong in the palace is happy to hear about the Queen’s pregnancy. However, So Yong can’t believe that she is pregnant and is not happy about it. Cheoljong is suspicious about So Yong’s reaction and he tries to comfort her. Meanwhile, a fierce rumour also starts to spread with the news of the Queen’s pregnancy.

Episodes.Title: The Counterattack of Memories
Episodes.Description: Cheoljong leaves the Palace to protect So Yong. So Yong worries about him as he disappears without any explanation. Meanwhile, the Grand Queen Dowager regains her regency as soon as Cheoljong leaves his spot, and she brings back Kim Jwa Geun to assist her. Byeong In tries to persuade So Yong to reconcile with the Kim clan, but she rejects his suggestion.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Came Back From The Dead
Episodes.Description: So Yong runs away from the Palace to look for Cheoljong, and Byeong In chases after her. Byeong In tries to kill So Yong on the edge of a cliff. Meanwhile, the Palace is busy with the preparation of the enthronement ceremony. However, someone goes around the streets and spreads the news that the King is still alive.

Episodes.Title: My Life Without Me
Episodes.Description: Cheoljong and So Yong plans to go back to the Palace in safety while Grand Queen Dowager and Kim Jwa Geun strictly restrict the entry. However, Bong Hwan’s soul suddenly leaves So Yong’s body when she is in danger. Will they be able to stop Kim Jwa Geun before the enthronement ceremony?

Entries.Title: Tale of the Nine Tailed
Entries.Description: A TV producer discovers a secret supernatural world as she becomes entangled with a former deity who's spent centuries searching for his lost lover.

Episodes.Title: The Incident That Occurred on Yeou Gogae
Episodes.Description: As a child, Nam Ji-a loses her parents. Two decades later, a curious case involving a runaway bride and a man with a red umbrella catches her attention.

Episodes.Title: I've Been Waiting for You
Episodes.Description: Recognizing Lee Yeon as her childhood savior, Ji-a thinks he might have a lead in locating her parents. A skull is discovered on a fishing boat.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of the Dragon King
Episodes.Description: A pattern emerges as Ji-a looks into the island's history of strange and suspicious deaths. Lee Rang keeps Yeon distracted.

Episodes.Title: Verge of Death
Episodes.Description: Rang pledges to hurt Yeon for his past actions. Before leaving for hell to serve his punishment, Yeon enjoys a home-cooked meal with Ji-a.

Episodes.Title: I Also Waited for You
Episodes.Description: As he recovers, Yeon opens up to Ji-a about his first love. Rang and Ki Yu-ri are unable to ignore a creature that is crying out for help.

Episodes.Title: Four Pillars of Destiny
Episodes.Description: While seeking information about Ji-a's parents, Yeon is reunited with an old acquaintance. Rang tries to get his hands on a valuable artifact.

Episodes.Title: The Trap of Samsara
Episodes.Description: Worried that Ji-a might not be safe without her fox marble, Yeon insists on keeping a close eye on her. Rang loses his special eyeglasses.

Episodes.Title: Reincarnation
Episodes.Description: The eyeglasses give Ji-a a peek into her tragic history with Yeon. A woman in green traps Rang and Ji-a inside their own minds.

Episodes.Title: Spirit of Darkness
Episodes.Description: Inside the forest of demons, Rang and Yeon fight to survive. Elsewhere, Ji-a begins to forget reality as she gives into a fantasy.

Episodes.Title: Deja-vu
Episodes.Description: Rang seeks a way to release himself from the binding debt he owes Kwon Hae-ryong. At work, Ji-a's team welcomes a new intern.

Episodes.Title: Ground Cherries
Episodes.Description: In a confrontation with Yeon, Imugi demonstrates the terrible power he possesses. A visit to death's door yields long-sought answers for Ji-a.

Episodes.Title: Catching Tails
Episodes.Description: Imugi interrupts Ji-a's newfound happiness with an unsettling appearance in her dreams. Yu-ri temporarily loses control over her actions.

Episodes.Title: The Other Imugi
Episodes.Description: With new revelations weighing heavily in their hearts, Ji-a and Yeon go on a getaway. Yeon identifies a weapon that could be the key to defeating Imugi.

Episodes.Title: Dead End
Episodes.Description: A mysterious plague sweeps across Seoul. Knowing that Ji-a's life is in greater danger than ever, Yeon proposes a risky alliance.

Episodes.Title: Without Knowing Imugi's Plan
Episodes.Description: While Yeon prepares to carry out his plan to put an end to Imugi's terror, Ji-a resolves to protect Yeon. Taluipa arrives at a difficult decision.

Episodes.Title: The Rewritten Tale of the Nine Tailed
Episodes.Description: Unable to move on, Ji-a begins a special project. Meanwhile, Rang refuses to give up on finding a way to bring Yeon back.

Entries.Title: Crash Landing on You
Entries.Description: A paragliding mishap drops a South Korean heiress in North Korea -- and into the life of an army officer, who decides he will help her hide.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Knocked out by fierce winds while paragliding through the air, Yun Se-ri wakes up on the north side of the Korean DMZ, where Ri Jeong Hyeok finds her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After talking Jeong Hyeok and his comrades into hiding her in his home, Se-ri gets a taste of his way of life. Gu Seung-jun buys refuge in Pyongyang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Jeong Hyeok invents a bold background story for Se-ri, but Cho Cheol Gang isn't so easy to fool. Seo Dan returns to North Korea.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: When her escape plan falls through, Se-ri turns to another idea for a way out. Dan heads to the village to see Jeong Hyeok.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Jeong Hyeok agrees to marry Dan sooner, as his parents wish, but they must do him a favor first. Seung-jun catches a glimpse of Se-ri.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Dan is less than happy when she hears Jeong Hyeok and Se-ri are at a hotel together. Meanwhile, Seung-jun plays what cards he has to save himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: A flight out of North Korea awaits Se-ri at the airport. But unwilling to leave Jeong Hyeok while he's injured, she brings him to the hospital instead.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Keeping Jeong Hyeok away from Se-ri turns out to be much more difficult than Seung-jun anticipated. Cheol Gang stays on their tail.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Se-ri faces her kidnapper. Elsewhere, Jeong Hyeok is forced to spread a formidable rumor about himself in order to escape Cheol Gang's clutches.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Back to her cushy life in the spotlight, Se-ri takes care of business — though nothing feels quite the same. Jeong Hyeok goes after Cheol Gang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
