Episodes.Description: It's Jeong Hyeok's turn to adjust to a new world. Back in North Korea, Dan gives Seung-jun a place to stay after he loses his protection.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Hoping to meet Jeong Hyeok, his comrades attend an event hosted by Se-ri's company. Seung-jun opens up to Dan over a bowl of rice porridge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Se-ri sends the comrades on a shopping spree, and plays hooky from work with Jeong Hyeok. Jung Man Bok encounters a dilemma.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: While Jeong Hyeok keeps watch over Se-ri, his comrades make themselves useful. Seung-jun can't stop worrying about Dan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: South Korean officials try to figure out what's going on, but they're given conflicting stories. Seung-jun flees from his captors.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Before departing, Jeong Hyeok leaves behind a surprise that keeps on giving. Dan delivers bittersweet justice.

Entries.Title: Arthdal Chronicles
Entries.Description: In a mythical land called Arth, the inhabitants of the ancient city of Arthdal and its surrounding regions vie for power as they build a new society.

Episodes.Title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy (1)
Episodes.Description: Sanung and the Saram propose an alliance with the blue-eyed Neanthal, but when things don’t go as expected, Tagon takes command of the Great Hunt.

Episodes.Title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy (2)
Episodes.Description: The villagers cast suspicion on Eunseom upon learning that he has dreams. Tanya questions her destiny. Tagon greets his men in an unlikely place.

Episodes.Title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy (3)
Episodes.Description: Upon finding Doti, Eunseom devises a plan to rescue the Wahan and is dismayed to learn the significance of Igutu - and what this means for him.

Episodes.Title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy (4)
Episodes.Description: Eunseom and Doti run into a familiar face in Arthdal and make an alarming discovery. Sanung grows suspicious of his son. Tanya stands up for her tribe.

Episodes.Title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy (5)
Episodes.Description: As Tagon’s declaration ripples through Arthdal, Eunseom contemplates the significance of what he saw. Mubaek seeks advice and is given a quest.

Episodes.Title: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy (6)
Episodes.Description: Taealha counsels Tagon about the impending meeting with Eunseom. Mihol tries to persuade Asa Ron to expose the truth. Tanya sees a mystifying vision.

Episodes.Title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land (1)
Episodes.Description: After a chance encounter, Tanya starts to grasp the meaning of the dream. Tagon’s plan upsets Taealha. Mubaek learns something astounding about Eunseom.

Episodes.Title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land (2)
Episodes.Description: Saya has chilling words for Taealha. Tagon strengthens his grip over Arthdal. Tanya receives news of Eunseom and wonders what Saya’s dreams might mean.

Episodes.Title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land (3)
Episodes.Description: Tanya proposes an alliance with Saya that proves to be useful for them both, Eunseom refuses to deny who he is, and ominous signs appear in Arthdal.

Episodes.Title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land (4)
Episodes.Description: Tagon visits Tanya and asks about the Wahan. After hearing about Tanya's dreams, Saya decides to tell her his story. Mubaek comes across something odd.

Episodes.Title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land (5)
Episodes.Description: Harim makes a startling confession to Mubaek. Chaeeun goes to see Tanya and tells her the truth about Eunseom. Mihol offers Taealha a way out.

Episodes.Title: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land (6)
Episodes.Description: Tagon becomes enraged when he discovers Mihol is behind Tanya’s abduction, and the two later meet to discuss her fate. Eunseom orchestrates an escape.

Episodes.Title: Part 3: Arth, The Prelude to All Legends (1)
Episodes.Description: Tanya becomes overwhelmed by Arthdal’s reception of her new role, and demands that Taealha and Tagon keep their end of the bargain.

Episodes.Title: Part 3: Arth, The Prelude to All Legends (2)
Episodes.Description: Mihol informs Tagon about the finer points of being a king. Saya’s appearance bewilders the Wahan. Eunseom receives help from the Neanthal.

Episodes.Title: Part 3: Arth, The Prelude to All Legends (3)
Episodes.Description: Surviving in Arthdal means knowing how to choose the side that holds power. Taealha is attacked, and Tagon silences those who’ve uncovered his secret.

Episodes.Title: Part 3: Arth, The Prelude to All Legends (4)
Episodes.Description: Tanya tries to uphold the ways of the Wahan but is dismayed to find that they have changed. Tagon’s guards make a gruesome discovery.

Episodes.Title: Part 3: Arth, The Prelude to All Legends (5)
Episodes.Description: Eunseom wrestles with a proposition and ponders how he’ll find Tanya. Saya plots a strategy for Tagon to be king. Mihol gives Taealha a stern warning.

Episodes.Title: Part 3: Arth, The Prelude to All Legends (6)
Episodes.Description: Tanya receives word of the Wahan and meets someone who’s seen Eunseom. Saya grows increasingly leery of those around him. Tagon gets what he wants.

Episodes.Title: The Weak Ones
Episodes.Description: Eight years has passed since Tagon took the throne as the second coming of Aramun. Eunseom succeeded in uniting the Ago clans as the second coming of Inaishingi and he leads them to the great war against Arthdal. Meanwhile, Saya must prove his worth to succeed Tagon.

Episodes.Title: The Battle of the Twins
Episodes.Description: The first battle between Arthdal, led by Saya, and the united Ago forces, led by Eunseom, takes place in Hanchoa. Eunseom and the Ago forces gets overwhelmed by Arthdal's military power. Meanwhile, Tagon realizes the elevated status of Tanya as the second coming of Asa Sin and begins to feel threatened by her absolute power.

Episodes.Title: The Lovers of Wahan
Episodes.Description: The united Ago forces faces an unforeseen situation, causing anxiety among its leadership that the alliance, which has been unified for 200 years, may fall apart. Meanwhile, Tanya is confronted with a truly incredible situation.

Episodes.Title: Purple Blood
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: The Sword of Aramun
Episodes.Description: The last prophecy by Aramun is announced. Eunseom, Tanya, and Saya try to figure out what it means!

Episodes.Title: Fake Inaishingi
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Ikomahis
Episodes.Description: Eunseom finds an unexpected breakthrough in despair. Saya's plan envelops Arthdal in fear.

Episodes.Title: The Most Powerful Creature Under the Sky
Episodes.Description: They need to stop Tagon. A brutal night falls on Arthdal. Eunseom advances close to Arthdal.

Episodes.Title: Remember My Face
Episodes.Description: The day of Tagon and Eunseom's battle comes. Tagon faces a shocking truth.

Episodes.Title: Whirlwind of Fire
Episodes.Description: Eunseom's Ago Union and Tagon's Arthdal have the final battle in the Arth Forest.

Episodes.Title: Heroines
Episodes.Description: Tanya who wants to change Arthdal's owner and Taealha who wants to protect Arthdal fight.

Episodes.Title: Arthdal Chronicles
Episodes.Description: The final battle between the Ago Union and Arthdal has come. Tagon prepares for a personal war. Tanya, Taealha, Saya, and Eunseom make one final move to protect what's most precious to them. Who will take over Arthdal?

Entries.Title: Vagabond
Entries.Description: Stuntman Cha Dal-geon gets involved in a tragic airplane crash and ends up discovering a national corruption scandal in the process. Go Hae-ri, the oldest daughter of a deceased marine, decides to work for the National Intelligence Service as a secret ops agent in order to support her mom and younger siblings, although all she wanted to do is to become a civil servant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Cha Dal-geon encourages his nephew to go to Morocco with the taekwondo demonstration group. Go Hae-ri walks in late to a meeting at the Korean embassy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Cha Dal-geon makes a disquieting announcement to the other bereaving families and implores Go Hae-ri for help, but she seems to be hiding something.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Hae-ri remains skeptical about the flight-deck voice recording but is told that the evidence points to a faulty aircraft. Dal-geon is ambushed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon gets a call from someone out of the blue and is approached by a journalist, who claims to be pursuing a story about the plane crash.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon attempts to alert the press about what he knows -- but someone interferes. Hae-ri contacts Gi Tae-ung to get answers about the flash drive.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The NIS takes Dal-geon to a safe house. Tae-ung questions O Sang-mi about her husband’s involvement in the plane crash but is ordered to release her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon sees someone who’s supposed to be dead. Hae-ri and Tae-ung head to Morocco to capture their suspect. The NIS takes Jessica Lee into custody.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon runs into trouble while trying to carry out his own search. Tae-ung is displeased that the operation in Morocco doesn’t go as planned.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon and the agents try to keep Kim Woo-gi alive, and request NIS backup. Jessica moves to pin the plane crash on someone else.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: After running from the embassy, Dal-geon and the others head back to Korea another way. Min Jae-sik confronts Gang Ju-cheol.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon and Hae-ri make contact with Jae-sik. Jessica and Yun Han-gi see a big win at the National Assembly. Tae-ung undergoes scrutiny.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: The plan to get Woo-gi safely to the courthouse takes an unanticipated turn -- and throws the Blue House into panic mode.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Dal-geon's explosive on-air accusation toward the president sparks a media storm. Jessica's press conference goes south quick.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: When O Sang-mi disappears, Dal-geon and Hae-ri realize there's more to the situation. Meanwhile, Hong Sun-jo takes advantage of the crisis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Sang-mi leaves behind a warning about a shady figure named Samael, putting everything Dal-geon thought he knew about the crash into question.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: When Jessica asks for NIS protection in exchange for Samael's identity, Hae-ri heads to prison undercover. In hiding, Dal-geon plans his next steps.

Entries.Title: Kingdom
Entries.Description: In this zombie thriller set in Korea's medieval Joseon dynasty which has been defeated by corruption and famine, a mysterious rumor of the king’s death spreads, as does a strange plague that renders the infected immune to death and hungry for flesh. The crown prince, fallen victim to a conspiracy, sets out on a journey to unveil the evil scheme and save his people.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Officials find notices in Hanyang alleging the king is dead. Crown Prince Lee Chang tries to check on his father, but the young queen stands in his way.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Prince Chang and Mu-yeong arrive at Jiyulheon, where they make a horrific discovery. Seo-bi’s story of what she saw eerily resonates with Prince Chang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Night leads to chaos in Dongnae. Cho Hak-ju and the queen oversee the king’s care. Prince Chang reaches a disquieting conclusion and vows to fight back.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: On his way to seek Lord Ahn Hyeon’s help, Prince Chang encounters a group of stranded survivors and leads them to Jiyulheon, following Seo-bi’s advice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Prince Chang’s group comes across a village that oddly seems to be well-fed. While taking refuge at Lord Ahn Hyeon’s, Seo-bi notes something peculiar.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Cho Hak-ju has chilling words for the queen, who’s hiding a sinister secret. Prince Chang orders Sangju’s defenses, but Seo-bi senses something awry.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: An unexpected setback in Sangju poses new problems for Prince Chang and the others. Seo-bi and Cho Beom-pal seek safety with Cho Hak-ju.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After Prince Chang breaks into Mungyeong Saejae, a nightmare unfolds. Officials search the queen's home, suspecting she is hiding something.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: When Cho Hak-ju is taken from his custody, Prince Chang goes after him. Seo-bi looks for a way to treat the disease. The queen awaits her prince.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Seo-bi shares a critical discovery with Prince Chang, who has a favor to ask of her. Cho Hak-ju visits the queen and demands she tell him the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: To save innocent lives, Prince Chang and his men take over Hanyang. The queen determines that if she can't have the throne, no one can.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: With the palace painted red with blood, Prince Chang is forced to pursue a risky strategy. Seo-bi takes the baby and hides.

Entries.Title: Hotel Del Luna
Entries.Description: When he's invited to manage a hotel for dead souls, an elite hotelier gets to know the establishment's ancient owner and her strange world.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Hotel Del Luna
Episodes.Description: On a day when the full moon has risen, Hotel Del Luna resumes its business. Two guests visit the hotel. One is a female dead soul who used to be a policewoman, but ended up being drowned in the water. The other one is a man who isn’t technically dead yet, but somehow ended up being lost after running away from the police.

Episodes.Title: Catch a Tiger
Episodes.Description: Chan Seong keeps seeing the dead souls. He comes to visit Man Weol and tells her to make him not to see the ghosts anymore. However, he’s given a mission to complete, and that is to catch a tiger. Meanwhile, Manager No, the only human in Hotel Del Luna, retires from his position.

Episodes.Title: In a Dream
Episodes.Description: Chan Seong sees a woman in his dream, and the woman looks like Man Weol. Chan Seong wants to know about the history of Hotel Del Luna and Man Weol’s past, but the staff at the hotel wouldn’t tell him. Meanwhile, a dead soul that committed suicide by leaping from the overpass shows up in front of Chan Seong.

Episodes.Title: Room 13
Episodes.Description: Man Weol tells Chan Seong to take good care of her. As Man Weol opens her heart to Chan Seong, new leaves start to sprout from the Moon Tree. Such a change agitates Man Weol and the staff of the hotel. They start to think everything has begun to change after Chan Seong joined the hotel. Meanwhile, the door to Room 13 is finally opened.

Episodes.Title: Dead Bride's Wish
Episodes.Description: A dead bride’s spirit comes to visit Hotel Del Luna. Chan Seong kindly shows in the guest. Seeing him taking good care of the female guest makes Man Weol jealous and upset. Meanwhile, a red pocket is found at a park. Any man who picks up the red pocket has to get married to the bride’s spirit.

Episodes.Title: Chan-sung's Ex-girlfriend
Episodes.Description: Man Weol plans to go out for a meal with Chan Seong. However, she hears from Sanchez that Mi Ra, Chan Seong’s ex-girlfriend, has shown up. Man Weol starts to feel jealous. Meanwhile, the spirit of a king of Joseon Dynasty checks in to Hotel Del Luna. All the staff members do their best to make sure that he has a comfortable stay.

Episodes.Title: Rival in Love
Episodes.Description: The evil spirit that has escaped from Room 13 continues to harm men. The spirit gets closer to the one that she’s after. Chan Seong decides to become the bait himself to catch the spirit. Meanwhile, Man Weol runs into Mi Ra who had an ill-fated relationship with Man Weol in the previous life.

Episodes.Title: Man-wol and Princess Song-hwa
Episodes.Description: Chan Seong finds out why Man Weol is tied down to Hotel Del Luna. In dreams, he happens to see what happened between Man Weol and Princess Song Hwa in the past. Meanwhile, Man Weol invites Mi Ra to Hotel Del Luna and plans to torment her.

Episodes.Title: Where Are You, Man-wol?
Episodes.Description: Hotel Del Luna disappears overnight. Chan Seong begins to trace Man Weol. The hotel staffers are having difficulty in dealing with all the work without Chan Seong. Meanwhile, Hyun Joong and Yu Na meet a group of spirits in the mountains on their way to the new hotel.

Episodes.Title: Chairman Wang's Offer
Episodes.Description: Man Weol realizes that Yeon Woo has been reincarnated as a man named Yeong Su and is now a detective in this world. And Mi Ra runs into Yeong Su on the street. Meanwhile, Chairman Wang says that he would like to arrange a date between his granddaughter and Chan Seong. Will Chan Seong accept the offer?

Episodes.Title: Lunar Eclipse
Episodes.Description: Man Weol and Chan Seong start to date without telling anyone in the hotel. A lunar eclipse occurs in 39 years, and humans get to see the presence of Hotel Del Luna. To greet special guests visiting on the day of the lunar eclipse, Chan Seong opens the door of Room 404. Meanwhile, Seol Ji Won, the serial killer, looks for Yu Na.

Episodes.Title: Ill-fated Relationship
Episodes.Description: Chan Seong is attacked by the serial killer, Seol Ji Won. Man Weol keeps calling Chan Seong, but he won’t answer. Man Weol thinks that something bad has happened to him. Then, Yu Na tells that she has seen an ambulance take a man to the hospital. Everyone at the hotel starts to worry about Chan Seong.

Episodes.Title: Seo-hee's Resentment
Episodes.Description: The flowers in the hotel start withering. The staff of the hotel wonders if it’s time to prepare to leave for the afterlife. Meanwhile, Seo Hee recognizes a new male guest. She realizes that it is a chance to resolve her deep sorrow and resentment before going to the afterlife. Also, Seo Ji Won, who has become a vengeful spirit, begins to harass Chan Seong’s acquaintances.

Episodes.Title: Man-wol's Choice
Episodes.Description: Man Weol is obsessed with the thought that Chung Myung might have been reincarnated as Chan Seong. She finally faces a choice for Chan Seong. Meanwhile, Chan Seong and the Grim Reaper find where Seol Ji Won is. When they arrive at the place, they meet Man Weol. Chan Seong is curious about what Man Weol is up to.

Episodes.Title: Chan-sung's Time Travel
Episodes.Description: While crossing the bridge to the afterlife, Man Weol starts to forget her memories piece by piece. Will Man Weol come back to Chan Seong? Meanwhile, Chan Seong travels back in time and gets to meet Man Weol in Joseon Dynasty. He has to find a herb there and returns to Hotel Del Luna.

Episodes.Title: Time to Say Goodbye
Episodes.Description: The staffers at the hotel prepare to leave for the afterlife one by one. Man Weol sees them off herself and realizes that there isn’t much time left for her. She also prepares to leave. Meanwhile, Mr. Kim decides to leave for the afterlife before he gets humiliated by the book that the dead author wrote. Man Weol and Chan Seong come up with an idea of clearing Mr. Kim’s name.

Entries.Title: The Tale of Nokdu
Entries.Description: While on the run for his life, a young man discovers that the best place to lie low is in a village of widows — disguised as a woman.

Episodes.Title: First Encounter
Episodes.Description: Nok-Du, who is living on a small island, witnesses his father and brother get attacked by a group of assassins. He decides to leave home and find out who they are and work for. He follows the leads and arrives in Hanyang.

Episodes.Title: Widow Village
Episodes.Description: Nok-Du disguises as a woman and enters the village where only widows are allowed to live. Fortunately, no one is suspicious of Nok-Du yet. He finds out that there's a gisaeng house right next to the widow village.

Episodes.Title: The Past of Nok-Du's Father
Episodes.Description: At night, Nok-Du happens to overhear the conversation of a group of widows who look like trained assassins. Nok-Du starts to follow one of them into the woods. Meanwhile, Nok-Du's father and brother move from the island to the mainland. Yun-Jeo, Nok-Du's father, decides to go to Hanyang to take care of unfinished business.

Episodes.Title: Like an Older Sister
Episodes.Description: Nok-Du and Dong-Ju become close. Nok-Du helps out Dong-Ju when she is having a hard time because of her injured hands. Dong-Ju says that she wants to treat Nok-Du like an older sister. Nok-Du happens to see a shaman and widows performing a religious ceremony, and he thinks that the widows are scheming something.

Episodes.Title: Composite Sketch
Episodes.Description: Dong-Ju realizes that Nok-Du has been pretending to be Lady Kim so far. Nok-Du persuades Dong-Ju to let him stay in the village. The widows talk about a man who sneaked into the village last night, and they plan to catch him by making a composite sketch of him. Nok-Du decides to give the widows misleading information about the man to confuse them.

Episodes.Title: I Want You to Leave
Episodes.Description: Dong-Ju hears a rumor about the man who broke into the village the other day. She realizes that it is not a good idea to let Nok-Du stay in the village. She asks Nok-Du to leave the village. Meanwhile, Nok-Du finds out that a group of widows is planning to kill someone, and he makes a deal with the widows.

Episodes.Title: Second Chance
Episodes.Description: Nok-Du decides to help Dong-Ju so she doesn't have to be a gisaeng. Nok-Du gives up the mission that the widows of Muweol Corps gave him. He goes to meet Lady Cheon with an idea that can help Dong-Joo. Meanwhile, the widows of Muweol Corps agree to give Nok-Du the second chance and order him to complete another mission.

Episodes.Title: Reminiscences of Childhood
Episodes.Description: Dong-Ju keeps being reminded of her childhood and family after she came to Hanyang. She visits the house she used to live when she was a child. That's when she runs into Yul-Mu. And Nok-Du happens to watch them have a chat from afar. Nok-Du manages to complete his mission, but he hears that the real Lady Kim and her servant got caught.

Episodes.Title: I Like Lord Yul Mu
Episodes.Description: Nok-Du returns to the village for widows with Dong-Ju and Yul-Mu after completing his mission in Hanyang. However, the widows and gisaengs in the village think that Nok-Du likes Yul-Mu. Meanwhile, Yun-Jeo and Hwang-Tae see that a group of assassins are in front of their place. They start to run away from the assassins.

Episodes.Title: Who Do You Like ?
Episodes.Description: Nok-Du is curious about who Dong-Ju likes. He asks her who it is, but she never tells him. Nok-Du decides to tell Dong-Ju his feelings for her, but Dong-Ju tries to keep her distance from Nok-Du.

Episodes.Title: Yul-Mu Knows Nok-Du's Secret
Episodes.Description: Yul-Mu finds out that Nok-Du has been pretending to be a woman all this time and that Dong-Ju has been looking out for Nok-Du. Yul-Mu wants to know if Dong-Ju has feelings for Nok-Du. And Nok-Du tells Dong-Ju that he will make her fall in love with him.

Episodes.Title: Yul-Mu's True Color
Episodes.Description: After the widows of Muweol Corps left for Hanyang to kill the local functionary, Nok-Du and Lady Cheon find out that the widows are in a trap. Lady Cheon asks Nok-Du to go help out the widows, and that's how Nok-Du becomes a member of Muweol Corps.

Episodes.Title: I Will Leave Soon
Episodes.Description: Heo Yun and his fellows think that the King might have noticed about their plan, so Heo Yun orders the widows of Muweol Corps to move their base. And Heo Yun encounters Hwang-Tae. Meanwhile, Nok-Du happens to overhear the conversation between Dong-Ju and Yul-Mu, and finds out that Dong-Ju is planning to leave.

Episodes.Title: Secret about Nok-Du's Birth
Episodes.Description: Nok-Du meets Hwang-Tae at Yul-Mu's house. Nok-Du insists that he and Hwang-Tae should hurry and leave the place, but Hwang-Tae refuses. Instead, Hwang-Tae tells Nok-Du a big secret.

Episodes.Title: Without Saying Goodbye
Episodes.Description: Because of the attack by Yul-Mu's underlings, the village for widows is destroyed and many widows get injured or killed. Nok-Du risks his life and helps the widows without disguising himself.

Episodes.Title: Reunion Between Father and Son
Episodes.Description: In Hanyang, Dong-Ju is trying to get a job in the palace by bribing court ladies. One day, a court lady asks Dong-Ju to find a man for her. Dong-Ju manages to find a man who matches the description. Meanwhile, Nok-Du visits Heo Yun again. Heo Yun takes Nok-Du to the room where Yun-Jeo is staying.

Episodes.Title: Yul-Mu Misleading Widows
Episodes.Description: When the widows of the Muweol Corps are confused and want to find out who is behind the death of Lady Cheon, Yul-Mu tells them that it was Heo Yun's order. He also suggests that the widows help him to create a new world. Meanwhile, Nok-Do tells Dong-Ju that he will never let her leave him again until she pays back what she owes him.

Episodes.Title: Trap for Yul-Mu
Episodes.Description: When Nok-Du and Dong-Ju are walking on the streets, an old lady stares at Dong-Ju as if she knows Dong-Ju. And Nok-Du and Dong-Ju run into the King again. The three of them go hiking to relieve the King's insomnia.

Episodes.Title: Heo Yun Framed
Episodes.Description: Nok-Du finally meets the King at the palace and is assigned to assist a senior chief administrative officer. Meanwhile, Heo Yun visits the King to warn that Yul-Mu should not be trusted and is plotting treason.

Episodes.Title: The Queen's Jewel
Episodes.Description: Heo Yun continues trying to convince that Yul-Mu is plotting treason, the King still doesn't believe him. Nok-Du runs into the Queen in the palace and notices that she is wearing the same jewel as the one he possesses.

Episodes.Title: Dong-Ju Enters the Palace
Episodes.Description: The King pays his visit to Heo Yun who is imprisoned in the dungeon, but this time, the King comes with Yul-Mu, Hwang-Tae, and two widows. Hwang-Tae and the widows make the false testimony to make Heo Yun a traitor. Meanwhile, Dong-Ju finally gets a job at the palace. Nok-Du visits her workplace and helps her work.

Episodes.Title: Your Son Is Alive
Episodes.Description: Yul-Mu finally finds Dong-Ju in the palace. He tries to take her somewhere, but Nok-Du stops him. Meanwhile, Yun-Jeo and the Queen secretly meet in a private house. Yun-Jeo tells that the Queen's son is still alive and that she should protect him from the King. Then, the door is opened, and an uninvited guest comes into the house.

Episodes.Title: Torturing Jung Yun-Jeo
Episodes.Description: Jung Yun-Jeo is taken to the prison, and Dong-Ju is shocked that the Chief Administrative Officer is the King. The King begins to torture Yun-Jeo. Every time he aims the sword at Yun-Jeo, he keeps seeing the face of Heo Yun, which makes him pass out.

Episodes.Title: Find the Merit List
Episodes.Description: Nok-Du plans with Ssook to steal the Merit List from Grand Prince Neungyang (Yul-Mu). In hopes of ruining the plan, Nok-Du goes to see the King with the Merit List. When Nok-Du sees the King and Yun-Jeo in prison, he happens to hear what’s truly on the King’s mind.

Episodes.Title: Nok-Du is the Boy
Episodes.Description: Dong-Ju finds out that Nok-Du is the biological son of the King she’s been despising for her life. Knowing the consequences that could be brought upon them, she ponders their relationship. Meanwhile, Nok-Du is promoted as the Royal Guard and is ordered to stay by the King at all times.

Episodes.Title: Go, Now !
Episodes.Description: Nok-Du spreads the rumors around the town about the King and himself. He plans to murder the King and undo the injustices that were caused due to him being alive. Dong-Ju also plans to not hide. Therefore she decides to end her relationship with Nok-Du.

Episodes.Title: A Revolt in Plan
Episodes.Description: Dong-Ju escapes from the palace and moves alone to kill the King. Meanwhile, Nok-Du escorts the King to his way to the shrines. One night, the King offers a drink to Nok-Du. He honestly shares his true feelings of loss in never being loved by his own father.

Episodes.Title: Dong-Ju Stands Before the King
Episodes.Description: The revolting army takes over the castle. Everyone seems to be after the King, but the King himself just realizes that his trusted royal guard Yeon-Su is actually Nok-Du. Enraged with betrayal, the King goes out in the middle of the night to search for Nok-Du.

Episodes.Title: Dong-ju and Nok-du Promise Forever
Episodes.Description: Dong-Ju and Nok-Du share their honest feelings toward each other. They promise to be together despite their complicated family history. Nok-Du takes off to fight against the revolt led by Grand Prince Neungyang (Yul-Mu).

Episodes.Title: The King is Back
Episodes.Description: Dong-ju can’t sit still and wait for Nok-du. She gathers her things and sets off to the palace to see how things are going. She enters the palace to see Neungyang (Yul-Mu) aiming at Nok-du and throws herself in front of his arrow. The battle continues and surprising news is shared throughout the palace.

Episodes.Title: Dong-ju’s Decision
Episodes.Description: Nok-du and Dong-ju manage to get out of the palace thanks to the Queen's help. Yul-mu and his men go after Nok-du and Dong-ju. However, Nok-du and Dong-ju end up being surrounded by Yul-mu's armed forces.

Episodes.Title: Wedding Ceremony
Episodes.Description: Nok-du volunteers to keep working with the widows. And the wedding ceremony for Nok-du and Dong-ju is held. Every resident on the island comes to celebrate the couple.

Entries.Title: Angel's Last Mission: Love
Entries.Description: As a punishment for meddling in human affairs, an angel faces the impossible task of finding a soulmate for a cold-hearted ballerina.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Fails to Receive the Cornea Donation
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo receives an invitation letter to the 20th anniversary party of Fantasia Cultural Foundation. On her way to take a walk, she hears Seung Hwan talking to the doctor on the phone. She asks the doctor if she can receive the cornea donation. Dan accidentally encounters Yeon Seo and observes her.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Goes to the Party
Episodes.Description: Dan goes to Yeon Seo’s place to find his handkerchief. Yeon Seo decides to go to the Fantasia’s party. At the party, Yeon Seo realizes that everyone is looking at her with pity. On the way back home, Yeon Seo and Seung Hwan get in a car accident, and Dan witnesses it.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Receives Cornea Donation
Episodes.Description: Dan saves Yeon Seo, but this insubordinate act angers his deity. Dan is in danger of being dissipated, but he gets one last chance. Meanwhile, Seung Hwan dies because of the car accident, and Yeon Seo gets to receive his cornea transplant since Seung Hwan had arranged it with Yeon Seo in advance.

Episodes.Title: Dan Becomes Yeon Seo's Secretary
Episodes.Description: Kang Woo joins the Fantasia Ballet Company as an artistic director, and he criticizes Ni Na harshly. Kang Woo announces to the ballet company that he will appoint Yeon Seo as the lead ballerina. Dan gets hired as Yeon Seo’s secretary and has a hard time working under ill-natured Yeon Seo.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Gets to See Dan's Wings
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo sees Dan’s wings, but she thinks that Dan is just a pervert. Kang Woo comes into Yeon Seo’s house, and Dan thinks Kang Woo is the culprit. Kang Woo meets Ni Na on his way home, and they have dinner together. During the meal, Ni Na goes to the restroom, and Kang Woo notices that she went to the restroom to throw up her dinner.

Episodes.Title: Kang Woo's Suggestion
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo and Dan go to the columbarium together, and it suddenly rains again. Kang Woo suggests that Yeon Seo should dance again, but she refuses. Yeon Seo gets to know that Kang Woo was the one who saved her on the day of the accident. Ni Na’s family goes to Yeon Seo’s house to celebrate her recovery, but Yeon Seo gets furious.

Episodes.Title: Dan Gets Arrested for Housebreaking
Episodes.Description: Dan gets arrested because Yeon Seo reports him for housebreaking. The video of Yeon Seo that Ni Na posted on her SNS becomes the talk of the town. Kang Woo announces to the Fantasia’s board of directors that Yeon Seo will hold the press conference to announce her comeback.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Practices to Walk on Her Own
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo encounters Dan at the place where they met for the first time, and she asks him to help her to walk on her own. Yeon Seo misunderstands that Dan is in love with her. Meanwhile, Dan tries to help Yeon Seo and Kang Woo spend time together. Yeon Seo successfully walks into the place of the press conference on her own, and Yeong Ja surprises.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Starts to Prepare for Her Comeback
Episodes.Description: After Dan kisses Yeon Seo, it suddenly rains. So Dan leaves Yeon Seo alone and runs away. Yeon Seo promises Kang Woo she will get back in shape within a week. Ni Na confesses her feelings to Kang Woo, but he rejects her. Meanwhile, Dan tells Yeon Seo to forget about what happened between two.

Episodes.Title: Hu Tells Dan a Story of the Angel Who Loved Human
Episodes.Description: Kang Woo asks Dan if he likes Yeon Seo as a woman. Dan asks Hu if it’s possible for an angel to love someone other than the deity. And Hu tells Dan a story about the angel who loved human 15 years ago. Meanwhile, Yeon Seo keeps practicing even though she hurts her foot, and Dan tries to stop her. At that moment, Yeon Seo asks Dan if he ever liked her.

Episodes.Title: The Day of the Fantasia's Night
Episodes.Description: Kang Woo tells Yeon Seo to go to the Fantasia’s Night to show the sponsors that she is the prima ballerina. Dan obtains a driver’s license to serve as Yeon Seo’s secretary, but his driving skill is poor. Yeon Seo attends the event, and Dan keeps an eye on her to prevent anything bad happens to her.

Episodes.Title: The Sponsors Oppose Yeon Seo's Comeback to Fantasia
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo makes a disturbance during the Fantasia’s Night. Because of her behavior, the sponsors oppose Yeon Seo’s return to Fantasia. Dan thinks that this is a setup. Meanwhile, Yeong Ja tells Yeon Seo to hand over the entire foundation to her. Dan tells Yeon Seo to give up on everything because he doesn’t want her to be in trouble.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Apologizes to the Sponsors
Episodes.Description: Dan tells Kang Woo that he can’t disappear yet. Yeong Ja gathers the sponsors for a meeting. Yeon Seo attends the meeting and apologizes to the sponsors. Meanwhile, Kang Woo tells the members of the ballet theatre that they will be fired if they don’t show up for tomorrow’s practice.

Episodes.Title: Kang Woo Gets to Know Dan's Identity
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo helps the corps to do volunteer work at the sanatorium. She tries to show her sincerity to them, so she tries her best. She suggests Kang Woo that he should hold an audition for "Giselle". Ni Na goes to Elena to ask her for help. Meanwhile, Kang Woo gets to know that Dan is an angel.

Episodes.Title: Dan Quits His Job
Episodes.Description: Dan quits his job as a secretary and leaves Yeon Seo’s house. Hu notices that Kang Woo is not an ordinary human. Yeong Ja tells Kang Woo that he should step down as a panel of the audition, and Kang Woo accepts her suggestion under the condition that the dancers will judge each other at the audition.

Episodes.Title: Dan's Old Memory Came Back
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo is having a hard time because she keeps thinking about Dan. She can’t even focus on the ballet practice, and Kang Woo worries about her. She gets drunk and goes to the place where she met Dan for the first time. Meanwhile, Dan tries to find the place that he keeps seeing in his dream, and he gets his old memory back.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo & Seong Woo's Old Memories
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo has a dream about her childhood friend named Seong Woo, and she goes to the island where she met him for the first time. She asks the villagers if they remember the boy, and she gets to know that the boy died a long time ago. Meanwhile, Yeon Seo and Dan get to meet each other on the island.

Episodes.Title: Dan's Promise to Yeon Seo
Episodes.Description: Dan promises Yeon Seo that he will come back to her soon. Kang Woo tells Yeon Seo that she can lean on him, but Yeon Seo tells Kang Woo not to cross the line again. Meanwhile, Yeong Ja and Ru Na are trying to win over the dancers to their side. Dan is suspicious of Kang Woo and he trespasses on Kang Woo’s house.

Episodes.Title: The Day Before the Audition
Episodes.Description: Hu gets to know that Kang Woo is the angel who loved a human. Yeon Seo asks Dan what is the story that he is hiding from her. Kang Woo gets to hear that Ru Na and Yeong Ja bought votes from the corps. Meanwhile, Yeon Seo keeps practicing her dance with Dan the day before her audition.

Episodes.Title: The Result of the Audition
Episodes.Description: Dan thinks that there must be a way for an angel to become a human. Ni Na and Yeon Seo both do a great job on the audition. After the audition, Kang Woo tells Yeon Seo that he will wait for her at the restaurant to say something. Meanwhile, Dan tries to talk about his identity to Yeon Seo, and it starts to rain at that moment.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo's Distorted Memory
Episodes.Description: After what happened to Yeon Seo at the rooftop of the ballet theatre, she can’t remember what happened to her that day. Kang Woo is suspicious of Yeong Ja and Ru Na for the kidnapping, but they deny it. Meanwhile, Dan worries about Yeon Seo, so he tells Yu Mi to strengthen the security of the Ivy Mansion.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Search for Dan's Secret
Episodes.Description: Yeong Ja gets to know that Ru Na schemed to kill Yeon Seo. Ni Na tells Kang Woo that she will be Yeon Seo’s understudy. Yeon Seo thinks Dan is hiding something from her, so she sneaks into his room. Meanwhile, Dan gets to know that Kang Woo was the angel who fell in love with a human.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Regains Her Memory
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo remembers everything, including the fact that she was kidnapped. Yeon Seo asks Dan if he really is an angel, and he admits to it. Meanwhile, Yeong Ja tells Ru Na that she shouldn’t plot anything without telling her first. Yu Mi and Yeon Seo notice that Gwang Il’s phone has been bugged.

Episodes.Title: Gwang Il's Statement
Episodes.Description: Dan asks Kang Woo how he could become a human, and Kang Woo tells Dan that Yeon Seo needs to die in order for him to become a human. Yeon Seo receives Gwang Il’s statement that confesses his wrongdoings by the instigation of Yeong Ja. Meanwhile, Kang Woo tells Yeon Seo that Dan will dissipate like dust because of her love.

Episodes.Title: Ki Chun's Confession
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo holds an emergency board meeting and tells the supporters that Yeong Ja, Ru Na, and Ki Chun will leave Fantasia. Ru Na begs for Yeon Seo’s mercy, but Yeon Seo tells her that she has no intention of forgiving them. Meanwhile, Dan wants to hear the answer from the deity, but the deity doesn’t respond.

Episodes.Title: Does Dan Finally Become a Human?
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo and Dan go on a picnic to the park where they first met. Yeon Seo wants to marry Dan because she thinks it is the only way for them to be together. Meanwhile, Dan falls down and gets hurt in the park, but his wound doesn’t heal itself as usual. They think this is a symptom of becoming a human and they wait for a rainy day to check if it’s real.

Episodes.Title: Dan's Proposal to Yeon Seo
Episodes.Description: Dan decides to disobey the deity’s will, and he proposes to Yeon Seo. Elena suggests Ni Na that she should hurt Yeon Seo in order to be Giselle. Hu warns Dan and Yeon Seo for the last time, but they won’t listen to him. Meanwhile, Dan goes to see Ru Na and gives her a warning not to hurt Yeon Seo once again.

Episodes.Title: Dan's & Yeon Seo's Wedding Day
Episodes.Description: Kang Woo tells Yeon Seo that it will be meaningless to Dan if she doesn’t exist in this world, and she notices that she should die in order to save Dan. Ni Na announces to her family that she will live by herself from now on, and Ru Na gets furious. Meanwhile, Dan and Yeon Seo’s wedding day comes, and they make a vow of their eternal love.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo Refuses to Perform
Episodes.Description: Ki Joon Soo tries to kill Dan, and Hu saves Dan at that time. Yeon Seo tells Kang Woo that she won’t perform on stage because there is no time left for Dan and Yeon Seo. Dan gets to hear that conversation and tells her that she needs to dance for his sake. Meanwhile, Dan and Yeon Seo get to find Hu’s report at the church and they realize Hu’s innermost feelings.

Episodes.Title: Ru Na’s Other Plot
Episodes.Description: Ru Na tries to hang herself in prison, so she is taken to the hospital. On the day of Fantasia’s show, Yeon Seo decides to show the most beautiful Giselle in the world to impress the deity. Meanwhile, Ru Na escapes from the hospital and sneaks into the theater. Ni Na tries to stop her, but Ru Na doesn’t care about her.

Episodes.Title: Dan's Disappearance
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo loses consciousness after her performance. Yeong Ja and Ki Chun go to the police station to see Ru Na, but Ru Na only concerns about whether Ni Na plays Giselle or not even in this situation. Dan wants to be by Yeon Seo's side, but there is no more time left for Dan. Meanwhile, Yeong Ja and Ki Chun come to Yeon Seo’s hospital to apologize to her.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Seo's Life without Dan
Episodes.Description: Yeon Seo comes back to home with Dan, and they spend time together happily. However, Yeon Seo realizes that it is her dream. Dan tells Yeon Seo to live happily without him and bids farewell to her. After her dream, Yeon Seo finally wakes up from a coma. After Dan’s disappearance, Yeon Seo tries to live bravely, but she keeps seeing a hallucination of Dan.
